seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Patrick Jane is a celebrity psychic whose wife and child are viciously murdered by an elusive serial killer called Red John. Devastated, Patrick admits his paranormal act is fake, renounces his earlier life and uses his astonishing skills of observation and analysis - talents that made him appear psychically gifted - to bring killers to justice. At crime scenes across California, Patrick now helps an elite team of detectives break their toughest cases. But no matter how many criminals he catches, Patrick never forgets his central goal: Find Red John. And bring him down.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: California Bureau of Investigation consultant Patrick Jane has a blatant lack of protocol but is self-assured and driven. The former "psychic" uses his talent for seeing the clues everyone else misses to solve the most baffling crimes. But there's more than crime: Lisbon and Cho reveal hints about their troubled pasts. Violence fells one CBI boss, and the new boss seems more interested in authority than teamwork. And as the Van Pelt-Rigsby relationship heats up, it threatens to cool down their careers.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Red John strikes into the heart of the CBI. Ever since the serial killer murdered Patrick Jane's family, the California Bureau of Investigation consultant and former faux-psychic has become obsessed with finding the man who destroyed his life. But after a homocide suspect is set ablaze in his jail cell and a CBI agent is later framed as Red John, Patrick realizes his adversary is closer than he imagined.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Patrick Jane was arrested for the public murder of the man he believes is the notorious serial killer Red John, who murdered his wife and daughter. Unless, of course, the man Patrick shot is someone else. With an upstart new boss, puzzling new cases, and Red John never far from his mind, the unconventional Patrick will need all his razor-sharp skills of observation, manipulative theatrics and smooth charm to sidestep the system that stands in the way of the truth.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview:
The assault, narcotics and fraud charges against Patrick Jane have been dropped and it's back to business as usual. Or business as unusual for Jane, who uses mind games, tricks and his super sharp skills of observation to solve the state's most puzzling homocides.

Jane's obsession with finding Red John consumes him every waking moment, drawing him outside the law and closer than ever to the serial killer's true identity. But when Homeland Security and the FBI team up with the CBI on the case, Jane's unorthodox methods antagonize even his most loyal allies. Can Jane's skill and charm continue to see him through? How far is too far?

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Armed with a list of seven suspects, confirmed by the killer himself, Patrick Jane and the CBI team are closing in on the elusive serial killer while continuing to solve California's most puzzling crimes. Could Red John be a cult leader? A ghoulish forensic analyst? A super-suspicious Homeland Security Agent? Or one of four law officials, including the director of the CBI himself? The identity of the man who killed Patrick Jane's family is finally revealed in a climactic showdown - but that's not the end of the story! When the CBI shuttered, Jane, Lisbon and the team partner with the FBI to tackle a whole new slew of mysteries... including vicious attack on former CBI members.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: With serial killer Red John laid to rest, Patrick Jane is finally free to close the door on his past and plan for the future. A fresh start with the FBI has him solving top-security cases alongside former CBI agents Teresa Lisbon and Kimball Cho, new colleagues Jason Wylie and Michelle Vega, and boss Agent Dennis Abbott. And Jane's blossoming connection with Lisbon brings a deeper bond to the partners' already intimate and intense professional relationship. But when femme fatale Erica Flynn resurfaces from Jane's past and another sadistic serial killer appears on the scene, affairs of the heart take a backseat to survival.

name: TAR - البراعم الحمراء
plot: مريم، التي أُجبرت على الزواج في سن الرابعة عشرة، تخاطر بكل شيء لإنقاذ ابنتها من نفس المصير. بمساعدة ليفينت، تخوض معارك ضد جروح الماضي وأسراره، وتكافح من أجل الأمل والحب.
cast: Özgü Namal, Özcan Deniz, Erkan Avcı, Mert Turak, Mert Yazıcıoğlu

name: AR - Pro Bono
plot: When a respected judge's world falls apart overnight, he joins a top law firm's pro bono team — where hope and purpose wait in humble, unexpected places.
cast: Jung Kyung-ho, So Joo-yeon, Lee You-young, Yoon Na-moo, Kang Hyung-suk

name: AR - Surely Tomorrow
plot: In their twenties, Lee Kyeong-do and Seo Ji-woo part ways after two passionate relationships. A decade later, they meet again as a reporter who covers an adultery scandal and the wife of the man at the center of that scandal. Reuniting in their late thirties, their youth has passed, but their love remains vivid. Kyeong-do now strives to prove to her and to himself that he still loves her.
cast: Park Seo-jun, Won Ji-an, Lee El, Lee Zoo-young, Kang Ki-doong

name: AR - ميدتيرم
plot: ما بين طموح وأفكار وتقاليع جيل 2 ، تطبيق واحد يقلب حياتهم رأسا على عقب !
cast: ياسمينا العبد, جلا هشام, يوسف رأفت, زياد ظاظا, Donia Wael

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The events of the series take place within the halls of an Egyptian university, where we follow the lives of a group of Egyptian and Arab students as they face academic pressures, psychological struggles, and emotional ups and downs that define university life. The story reflects each character’s journey in searching for their identity and pursuing their ambitions amid the real-life challenges faced by their generation.

name: AR - وينك من زمان
plot: قصة حب بين دلال الشيف الطموحة وطلال الذي ما زال يتعافى بعد خروجه من علاقة سامة, يتقابلان من خلال حادث وسرعان ما يقعان في الحب ويقرران الزواج. لكن نراقب من خلال علاقتهما الاختلاف بين شخصياتهم الذى يتسبب في مشاكل عديدة تهدد بنهاية العلاقة, ليجتمعا في النهاية على أسس جديدة من الثقة والشراكة الحقيقية.
cast: فرح الصراف, ناصر الدوسري, زينب بهمن, أحمد النجار, مرام البلوشي

name: AR - مش مهم الاسم
plot: يركن يزن السيارات في النهار، وتلاحقه الحقيقة من الخلف. ينساق إلى كذبة صاخبة حين يدعي أنه ابن رجل ثري، لكن ظهور لارا في حياته يقلب كل شيء… فتمسك المشاعر بمقود الرحلة، حيث تتلاشى الحدود بين الهويات وتشتعل شرارة الحب.

name: FR - Young Justice
plot: Teenage superheroes strive to prove themselves as members of the Justice League.
cast: Jesse McCartney, Khary Payton, Nolan North, Danica McKellar, Stephanie Lemelin

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Robin, Aqualad, Kid Flash, Superboy, Miss Martian, and Artemis form Young Justice -- and find out whether they have what it takes to be a proven hero.

seasons.name: Invasion
seasons.overview: In Season 2, we pick up with the team five years later, as they fight off a secret alien invasion affecting the entire planet.

seasons.name: Outsiders
seasons.overview: In Season 3, the team faces its greatest challenge yet as it takes on meta-human trafficking and the terrifying threat it creates for a society caught in the crossfire of a global and galaxy-wide genetic arms race.

seasons.name: Phantoms
seasons.overview: The original team—Nightwing, Aquaman, Superboy, Miss Martian, Tigress, Zatanna and Rocket—are back, leading a new generation of young heroes on a quest for justice across the Earth, the Solar System, the Galaxy and beyond. Between Order and Chaos, through time and space, life and death battles will be fought, won and lost. Who will rise? Who will fall? And who will haunt them forever?

name: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur
plot: Et si Ashur… n'était pas mort sur le Vésuve ? Et si on lui avait offert la formation des gladiateurs qui appartenait autrefois à Batiatus en échange de son aide aux Romains pour tuer Spartacus et mettre fin à la rébellion des esclaves ?
cast: Nick E. Tarabay, Graham McTavish, Tenika Davis, Jamaica Vaughan, Ivana Baquero

name: FR - Les Belles Histoires des pays d'en haut
FR - Bluey
plot: Suivez les aventures de Bluey, qui vit avec sa mère, son père et sa sœur. Son énergie irrésistible et son esprit d'aventurière, l'emportent dans une série de situations tout autant drôles qu'imprévisibles.
cast: Dave McCormack, Melanie Zanetti

name: AR - 2 قهوة
plot: دراما رومانسية اجتماعية تدور حول قصة حب تنشأ بالصدفة بين أستاذ جامعي مقدم برامج ناجح، وفتاة بسيطة تعمل في مقهى. تتطور العلاقة بينهما وسط صراعات ماضية وعقبات اجتماعية ومهنية، خصوصًا بعد عودة طليقته إلى حياته، مما يهدد استقرار الحب الجديد.
cast: أحمد فهمي, مرام علي, محسن محيي الدين, ميريت عمر الحريري, عمر رياض

name: FR - Malgré moi
plot: Dans un vol Winnipeg-Montréal, Daphné raconte comment elle a tout laissé à Montréal pour suivre l’amour de sa vie à Winnipeg, Ilunga, et y trouver plutôt une trahison monumentale. Humiliée, elle qui planifiait se venger aurait-elle plutôt trouvé une famille choisie?
cast: Schelby Jean-Baptiste, Mikaël Conde, Stéphanie Morin, Eddy King, Micheline Marchildon

name: FR - The Price Of Confession
cast: Jun Do-yeon, 김고은, Park Hae-soo, Jin Seon-kyu, Choi Young-joon

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: An Yun Su's humble dream of a happy family life is destroyed when her husband is murdered. She struggles to prove her innocence in his mysterious death. Once in prison, Mo-eun, a mysterious figure called a witch among prison inmates due to her uncanny ability to read people, appears before the distressed Yun Su. The fateful encounter between these two women has its own repercussions, and two men relentlessly pursue the truth: Baek Dong Hun, a conscientious prosecutor who never loses his composure, and Jang Jeong-Gu, Yun Su's lawyer and a former boxer who packs a punch in each and every case.

name: FR - Sean Combs : L'heure des comptes
plot: Cette série documentaire décrypte les accusations choquantes qui visent Sean "Diddy" Combs et son empire Bad Boy, couvrant plusieurs années de sa vie et de sa carrière.
cast: Sean Combs

name: AR - The Believers
plot: When their startup goes deep into debt, three entrepreneurs stage a risky scam using a Buddhist temple to pay back a massive loan before time runs out.
cast: Teeradon Supapunpinyo, Achiraya Nitibhon, Pachara Chirathivat

name: EAR - The Abandons
plot: In 1850s Washington, two families led by powerful matriarchs — one wealthy, one poor but deeply loyal — battle for supremacy on the lawless frontier.
cast: Lena Headey, Gillian Anderson, Nick Robinson, Diana Silvers, Lucas Till

name: AR - GBRB: Joy Pops Laugh Pops
plot:
Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo are back with a hilarious new spin-off of the beloved “GBRB” series!

GBRB: Joy Pops Laugh Pops,” which will follow the trio as they set off on a whirlwind trip to Mexico in search of fresh perspectives and experiences.

The program is a spinoff of “GBRB Spinoff: Cafeteria Operation,” where the KKPP Food employees successfully completed their missions and earned the chance to go abroad for an insight trip to help the company grow. It also marks the second spinoff of “GBRB: Reap What You Sow.”
cast: Lee Kwang-soo, Kim Woo-bin, Doh Kyung-soo

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Returning as the second spin-off of GBRB: Reap What You Sow, three popular stars, Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo, are gearing up for a chaotic yet heartwarming adventure abroad in GBRB: Joy Pops Laugh Pops. The show follows KKPP Food’s Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo as they set off on a whirlwind trip to Mexico in search of insights to help their company grow. Together, this trio personally handles every aspect of their overseas journey, from destinations and accommodations to activities, while struggling with tight budgets and even negotiating along the way.

name: FR - The Abandons
plot: In 1850s Washington, two families led by powerful matriarchs — one wealthy, one poor but deeply loyal — battle for supremacy on the lawless frontier.
cast: Lena Headey, Gillian Anderson, Nick Robinson, Diana Silvers, Lucas Till

name: FR - Les secrets du Skinwalker Ranch
plot:
Alors que la plupart des gens se tournent vers les étoiles pour trouver une vie extraterrestre, un groupe de chercheurs fait le contraire : ils cherchent sous terre. Depuis plus de 200 ans, le ranch Skinwalker de l'Utah a été le témoin de centaines d'activités paranormales et d'ovnis.

Malgré des décennies d'études, dont certaines sont secrètement financées par le gouvernement américain, personne n'a osé chercher dans les sols. Aujourd'hui, le légendaire ranch donne un accès complet à une équipe qui se prépare à faire ce qui n'a jamais été fait auparavant.
cast: Travis Taylor, Brandon Fugal, Bryant “Dragon” Arnold, Tom Winterton, Erik Bard

name: FR - Delhi Crime
plot: Inspirée de faits réels et imaginaires, cette série suit les enquêtes d'une brigade de police de Delhi sur des crimes très médiatisés.
cast: Shefali Shah, Rasika Dugal, Avijit Dutt, Adil Hussain, Yashaswini Dayama

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As Delhi reels in the aftermath of a gang rape, DCP Vartika Chaturvedi leads a painstaking search for the culprits. Inspired by the 2012 Nirbhaya case.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: When a chain of distinctly grisly murders suggests the return of a feared criminal gang, DCP Vartika heads the case under media and public pressure.

name: FR - Toujours Canadiens
cast: Serge Savard, Guy Carbonneau, Chris Nilan, Stéphane Richer, Claude Lemieux

name: FR - Sekizinci Aile [VOSTFR]
cast: Haluk Bilginer, Hazal Kaya, Ercan Kesal, Mehmet Özgür, Ali Atay

name: EAR - Caroline Flack: Search for the Truth
plot: Follow Caroline's mother, Christine, as she investigates the truth about her daughter's final months - uncovering new shocking details, asking difficult questions, and exposing the misrepresentations, pressures, and failures from institutions and decision makers that shaped Caroline's final days.
cast: Christine Flack

name: EAR - Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films
plot: This two-part documentary provides a fascinating glimpse into the making of the Oscar-winning box office phenomenon "Avatar: The Way of Water" and features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, concept art, and interviews with cast and filmmakers.
cast: James Cameron

name: FR - Suits LA
plot: Ted Black, un ancien procureur fédéral de New York, a su se réinventer et représenter les clients les plus influents de Los Angeles. Mais son cabinet est au bord de la faillite et, pour survivre, il doit embrasser un rôle qu'il a toujours méprisé.
cast: Stephen Amell, Lex Scott Davis, Josh McDermitt, Bryan Greenberg

name: FR - Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation
plot: Autrefois, les Sept Grands régnaient sur leurs domaines respectifs à Twisted-Wonderland, un monde rempli de magie. Leurs glorieuses actions ont fait d’eux des légendes et la prestigieuse université de magie Night Raven dédia ses sept dortoirs à ces illustres figures : la Reine de Cœur, le Roi des animaux, la Sorcière des mers, le Sorcier des sables, la plus belle Reine, le Roi des Enfers et la Fée des ronces. Mais Yuken (Yu), un jeune lycéen, ignorait l’existence de ce monde avant d’être transporté en pleine nuit à la cérémonie de bienvenue de l’académie Night Raven. Il doit maintenant affronter des monstres, des apprentis magiciens fantasques et des situations mystérieuses, tout ça, sans posséder de magie. Yu réussira-t-il à retourner dans son monde ?
cast: 阿座上洋平, Natsuki Hanae, 山下誠一郎, 小林千晃, Ryōta Suzuki

name: EAR - Love Is Blind: Italy
plot: A group of singles who want to be loved for who they are will have the opportunity to search for their soulmate without the distractions of the outside world and will choose someone to marry without ever meeting them face-to-face. When their wedding day arrives, will real-world realities and external factors push them apart, or will they marry the person they fell blindly in love with?
cast: Fabio Caressa, Benedetta Parodi

name: FR - Ardennes
plot: Vivant dans un manoir isolé en Champagne-Ardennes, Olivier Rimbaud, un psychiatre charmeur et mystérieux, partage son quotidien entre ses patients, le profiling qu'il exerce pour aider la police sur des affaires hors norme et ses efforts pour cacher un passé douteux.
cast: David Hallyday, Lubna Azabal, Ben Attal, Pol White, Samuel Mercer

name: FR - The Hack [VOSTFR]
plot: Se déroulant entre 2002 et 2012, ce drame entremêle habilement deux histoires vraies : la révélation des écoutes téléphoniques illégales pratiquées par le journal News of the World et, en parallèle, l'enquête sur le meurtre non élucidé du détective privé Daniel Morgan.
cast: David Tennant, Robert Carlyle, Rose Leslie, Dougray Scott, Toby Jones

name: AR - The glory
plot: قصة إنتقام حزينة بدأت مع طالبة ثانوية كانت تحلم بأن تصبح مهندسة معمارية. لكنها تترك المدرسة بعد أن تعرضت إلى تنمر وعنف جسدي بالمدرسة. بعد سنوات، المتنمرة تتزوج وتنجب طفل. بعد دخول الطفل المدرسة تكون الضحية هي معلمته. لتبدأ تراوضها أفكار عن الإنتقام من المتنمرة بنفس طريقة التنمر في الماضي.
cast: 송혜교, 이도현, 임지연, يوم هي ران, 박성훈

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A high school student dreams of becoming an architect. However, she had to drop out of school after suffering from brutal school violence. Years later, the perpetrator gets married and has a kid. Once the kid is in elementary school, the former victim becomes her homeroom teacher and starts her thorough revenge towards the perpetrators and bystanders of her bullying days.

name: FR - Requiem for Selina
plot: Requiem for Selina raconte comment Selina se perd dans sa quête de célébrité, d’affirmation et d’appartenance. Requiem pour son âme et lamentation narrative d’une jeune fille naïve et intimidée qui meurt quelque part en cours de route, en faveur de son alter ego Celina Isabelle, la plus grande blogueuse du pays. En tentant de se venger de ses bourreaux, Selina change accidentellement le monde. Voici l’histoire de la première blogueuse beauté au monde, inspirée de faits réels.
cast: Elli Rhiannon Müller Osborne, Oliver Sletvold Andersen, Veslemøy Mørkrid, Pål Sverre Hagen, Maren Dale

name: TAR - مثل الحلم
plot: أيدان، مصففة شعر بسيطة، تجد حياتها تنقلب رأسًا على عقب عندما تصبح فجأة مالكة لمركز تجميل فاخر مرتبط برجل الأعمال الغامض إمير. وبين مشاكل شريكتها المتمردة تشيغدم، وملاحقة مفتش جريء لهما، تحاول أيدان التأقلم مع عالمها الجديد المليء بالفوضى. ويزداد الوضع تعقيدًا مع ظهور زوجها السابق طارق، الذي يرفض الاعتراف بتغيّر حياتها ونجاحها.
cast: Seda Bakan, Uğur Güneş, Ahsen Eroğlu, Emre Bey, Şebnem Bozoklu

name: EAR - Sandokan
plot: Sandokan is a Malaysian pirate who, along with his friend Yanez and their crew, attacks the British forces from his island of Mompracem. During his adventures, he falls in love with Lady Marianna Guillonk, an English-Italian aristocrat.
cast: Can Yaman, Ed Westwick, John Hannah, Owen Teale, Lucy Gaskell

name: EAR - Sean Combs: The Reckoning
plot: This documentary series unpacks the shocking allegations behind Sean "Diddy" Combs and his Bad Boy empire, spanning decades of his life and career.
cast: Sean Combs

name: EAR - Who Killed Little Gregory?
plot: When their 4-year-old son is murdered, a young couple fights a twisting and arduous battle trying to identify a frustratingly elusive killer.

name: FR - Gang War: Pusher Street
plot: L'histoire d'une rue devenue l'épicentre du trafic de drogue au Danemark, racontée par ceux qui se sont battus pour, contre et au milieu de tout cela.
cast: Carsten Norton, Jesper Vestergaard Larsen, Bjarne Christensen, Tonny Kluck, Karl Bille

name: FR - Snowfall
plot: Los Angeles. 1983. A storm is coming and its name is crack. Set against the infancy of the crack cocaine epidemic and its ultimate radical impact on the culture as we know it, the story follows numerous characters on a violent collision course.
cast: Damson Idris, Carter Hudson, Sergio Peris-Mencheta, Michael Hyatt, Amin Joseph

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 enters 1984, with everyone working toward their ultimate goals of money, power, and influence amid the Los Angeles crack cocaine epidemic.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In Season 3, crack cocaine is spreading like wildfire through South Central Los Angeles, continuing its path of destruction and changing the culture forever.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In season four, Franklin tries to regain control over his business.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Set in the summer of 1986, Franklin Saint  and his entire family are rich beyond their wildest dreams, on the verge of having everything they've ever wanted... right as the ground begins to fall out from under their feet. The sudden and tragic death of basketball star Len Bias makes the rock cocaine epidemic front-page news, the target of both Democrat and Republican lawmakers. Law enforcement is on a warpath and the militarization of the L.A.P.D. continues as police and politicians decide the only way to deal with this growing scourge is through force - and the creation of the new C.R.A.S.H. (Community Resources Against Street Hoodlums) units. The streets of South Central Los Angeles have never been so dangerous as the Saint family navigates the police, the warring gangs and the CIA.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: It’s October 1986 in this sixth and final season, as civil war threatens to destroy the Saint family. Franklin is desperate and forced to rob his Aunt Louie and Uncle Jerome after being wiped out by former CIA officer Teddy McDonald. Meanwhile, Louie has taken over Franklin’s role as Teddy’s sole buyer, undercutting her nephew and creating a competing empire in the process. Franklin is now faced with losing everyone he loves and everything he’s built, and coming through it all will mean out-maneuvering the KGB, the DEA and the CIA, as well as avoiding the LAPD’s fully militarized, fully corrupt, C.R.A.S.H units.

name: FR - Angela Diniz : assassinée et accusée
plot: D'après des faits réels, cette série suit la mondaine Ângela Diniz, dont le procès pour meurtre devient un événement marquant dans l'histoire du pays.
cast: Marjorie Estiano, Emílio Dantas, Antônio Fagundes, Thiago Lacerda, Camila Márdila

name: FR - Sean Combs : L'heure des comptes [VOSTFR]
plot: Cette série documentaire décrypte les accusations choquantes qui visent Sean "Diddy" Combs et son empire Bad Boy, couvrant plusieurs années de sa vie et de sa carrière.
cast: Sean Combs

name: FR - The Alibi [VOSTFR]
plot: Vincent, héritier d'un empire médiatique, est accusé d'avoir tué son rival, Walter. Pour protéger sa réputation, il engage Stella, une escorte au passé tourmenté, afin qu'elle lui serve d'alibi.
cast: Paulo Avelino, Kim Chiu, John Arcilla, Zsa Zsa Padilla, Rafael Rosell

name: AR - ليلة فونطاستيك مع أبلة فاهيتا
plot: تشعل أبلة فاهيتا الأجواء في "ليلة فونطاستيك"! سهرة تتألق بالنجوم والفقرات اللي ما تتفوتش... بين الغناء والفرفشة وأفشات الأبلة اللي محدش بيسلم منها!
cast: أبلة فاهيتا, Caro, أسماء جلال

name: FR - Couchsurfing : Le prédateur des vacances
plot: Témoignage de trois jeunes femmes qui sont passées par le site Couchsurfing et qui se sont retrouvées victimes d'un prédateur sexuel italien.
cast: Anna Ackerman, Cecilia Anesi, Kate Jones, Alessia Cerantola

name: FR - Chespirito : Sans le vouloir
plot: Un regard sincère sur l'ascension de l'icône culturelle mexicaine Roberto Gómez Bolaños, mieux connu sous le nom de « Chespirito ».
cast: Pablo Cruz Guerrero, Paulina Dávila, Bárbara López, Arturo Barba, Juan Lecanda

name: FR - Mukbang
plot: Quand Kim découvre les « mukbangs », des spectacles en ligne où des gens mangent d'énormes quantités de bouffe, elle décide d'en faire sa carrière.
cast: Léanne Désilets, Geneviève Brouillette, Sophie Desmarais, Sasha Migliarese, Amaryllis Tremblay

name: FR - Revival
plot: Un jour miraculeux, dans une petite ville rurale du Wisconsin, les morts sortent soudain de leurs tombes. Mais ce n’est pas une histoire de zombies : les revenants sont exactement comme avant, en chair, en os… et apparemment bien vivants. Quand Dana Cypress, flic locale et mère célibataire, se retrouve plongée au cœur d’un meurtre aussi violent qu’inexplicable, elle doit démêler les fils d’une affaire qui plonge la ville dans la peur et la paranoïa. Car désormais, qu’on soit mort ou vivant, tout le monde est suspect.
cast: Melanie Scrofano, Romy Weltman, David James Elliott, Andy McQueen

name: EAR - Into the Night
plot: When the sun suddenly starts killing everything in its path, passengers on an overnight flight from Brussels attempt to survive by any means necessary.
cast: Pauline Étienne, Laurent Capelluto, Jan Bijvoet, Mehmet Kurtuluş, Alba Gaïa Bellugi

name: FR - Rivalité passionnée
plot: Two of the biggest stars in Major League Hockey are bound by ambition, rivalry, and a magnetic pull neither of them fully understands. What begins as a secret fling between two fresh faced rookies evolves into a years-long journey of love, denial, and self-discovery. Over the next eight years, as they chase glory on the ice, they struggle to navigate their feelings for each other. Torn between the sport they live for and the love they can’t ignore, they must decide if there’s room in their fiercely competitive world for something as fragile – and powerful – as real love.
cast: Connor Storrie, Hudson Williams, François Arnaud, Robbie Graham-Kuntz, Sophie Nélisse

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Two hockey players must decide if there is room in their fiercely competitive world for real love.

name: FR - Les aventurières
plot: La vie de Françoise, hôtesse de l’air à la retraite, et de sa fille Sophie volent en éclat le jour où leur mari et père, JP, est enlevé. Sophie découvre alors que sa mère et son père étaient des agents pour le compte de l’Etat dans un département non officiel de restitution d'œuvres d’art : toute sa vie est bâtie sur un mensonge. En échange du père, le ravisseur, Thompson, ne demande rien de moins que "Leda et le Cygne", un tableau de Léonard de Vinci disparu depuis plus de trois siècles. Françoise va devoir faire équipe avec sa fille, qui lui en a toujours voulu d’être une mère absente…
cast: Fanny Cottençon, Charlie Bruneau, Lionnel Astier, Thibault de Montalembert, Bruno Sanches

name: FR - Would You Marry Me [VOSTFR]
cast: Choi Woo-shik, 정소민, 신슬기, 배나라, Seo Bum-june

name: FR - SUPERmad
plot: Après avoir été violée, Amélie, une femme de chambre, développe des super pouvoirs qui lui permettent d'identifier et de combattre les délinquants sexuels. Elle juge le bien et le mal et réprime son propre traumatisme… Jusqu’à ce qu’elle rencontre de manière inattendue son propre violeur. La série explore les thèmes du traumatisme, de la justice et de la rédemption, tout en offrant une perspective féministe sur la lutte contre les violences sexuelles. Programmation spéciale à l’occasion de la Journée internationale pour l'élimination de la violence à l'égard des femmes.
cast: Marie Bloching, Bless Amada, Shakiba Eftekhari-Fard, Odine Johne, Martin Bruchmann

name: FR - ORELSAN : Yoroï, un an dans l'armure
FR - Les Sauvages
plot: Elevés par un père célibataire, les frères Savages ont épuisé une bonne vingtaine de gouvernantes. Nick s'efforce désormais d'apprendre à ses fistons à être indépendant et de se plier aux tâches ménagères. Mais la partie n'est pas gagnée Nick est lui-même un éternel adolescent... A story of three female friends who are 41 years old.

Cho Na Jeong used to be a TV home shopping host and earned hundreds of millions of won for her work. Now, she is a full-time housewife and mother to two sons. She tries to make a comeback as a home shopping host and earn the high salary she once made.

Koo Ju Yeong works as a planning manager at an art center which displays high-quality performances. She seems to have a perfect life in both her personal and business life. In fact, she endures pain while trying to have a baby with her asexual husband.

Lee Il Ri is single and works as a deputy editor-in-chief for a fashion magazine. She started her career as a fashion editor and has worked her way up to deputy editor-in-chief. She still holds a fantasy about marriage, a dream that she hasn't yet achieved.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Set nearly 200 years before Game of Thrones, this season chronicles the events leading up to the Targaryen civil war, known as the Dance of the Dragons. King Viserys I Targaryen names his daughter, Princess Rhaenyra, as heir to the Iron Throne, breaking tradition and igniting tensions within the realm. The court becomes divided as Queen Alicent Hightower, Viserys’s second wife, promotes her son Aegon’s claim to the throne. Political intrigue, shifting alliances, and personal betrayals set the stage for a looming conflict that threatens to tear the Targaryen dynasty apart.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Dance of the Dragons erupts as Rhaenyra and Aegon II both assert their claims to the Iron Throne, plunging Westeros into a brutal civil war. The season delves into the complexities of loyalty, power, and family as both sides employ dragons and armies to assert dominance. Key events include the tragic assassination of Prince Jaehaerys, escalating the conflict, and the shifting dynamics among key players like Daemon Targaryen and Alicent Hightower. As the war intensifies, the realm witnesses the devastating consequences of ambition and the high cost of succession disputes.

name: FR - Désenchantées
plot:
La disparition de Sarah Leroy, quinze ans, a bouleversé la petite bourgade de Bouville-sur-Mer et ému la France entière. Un coupable fut vite arrêté. Pourtant, dans chaque foyer, chaque bistrot, on continuait à élaborer des hypothèses. Ce qui est vraiment arrivé, personne ne l’a jamais su.

Vingt ans plus tard, Fanny, journaliste, revient sur les lieux de ce drame qui a marqué sa jeunesse. Et c’est tout un passé qui resurgit ... Car l’histoire de Sarah Leroy, c’est aussi un peu la sienne, de sa sœur Angélique et celle d’une bande de filles "les Désenchantées" qui ne connaissait que trop bien Sarah. Une histoire qui a l’odeur du chlore de la piscine municipale, des serments d’amitié et, surtout, des plus lourds secrets.

Synopsis: A society stands at a boiling point, where even the smallest disputes erupt into explosive conflicts. This is the era of indignation, where communication has broken down and collective fury simmers. People are quick to anger, and even quicker to fight.

Into this chaos steps one man, Mr. Shin. A master of words, he intervenes at the height of tension, diffusing outbursts with a single, perfectly chosen sentence. He doesn’t fight, he talks. His power lies in a rare gift for de-escalation, compelling even the most stubborn to accept his solutions.

This series follows Mr. Shin as he takes on conflicts ranging from hostile neighbours to fractured families. Can one man’s words alter the course of an entire society? Watch as this master negotiator works his magic.

Des policiers et des douaniers soumis à de brutales tentatives de corruption. Ça ne se passe pas en Amérique du sud, en Colombie ou en Equateur, terre des cartels tout puissants, mais en Europe, au Pays Bas, en Belgique, en France.  Les trafiquants de drogue sont entrés en guerre contre les États européens. Devenus tout puissants grâce aux énormes revenus générés par la cocaïne, ils ne reculent devant aucune violence pour prendre le contrôle des ports ou échapper à la justice. plot: Francois 'Frank' Crutchfield or 'Crutch' to those who know him well, is a Harlem widower whose empty-nest plans are put on hold after his millennial son and free-spirited daughter move back home.

name: FR - All's Fair

name: FR - Crutch

Mais son quotidien est bouleversé quand son fils, adepte d’un style de vie sophistiqué, et sa fille, au tempérament libre, reviennent vivre sous son toit. Entre générations, caractères et habitudes de quartier, la cohabitation s’annonce mouvementée.
cast: Tracy Morgan, Jermaine Fowler, Adrianna Mitchell, Kecia Lewis

cast: Jack Patten, Lauren McQueen, Sean Bean, Connie Nielsen, Lydia Peckham

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 12th-century England, Robert of Locksley rises from grief to rebellion. With Marian at his side and outlaws at his back, Rob defies the Sheriff of Nottingham and Norman rule. His fight for freedom will give birth to the legend of Robin Hood.

name: FR - I Love LA
plot: Cette série suit un groupe d'amis soudés qui se réunit après des années de séparation, naviguant dans les complexités de l'ambition, des relations et de la façon dont le temps les a changées.

name: FR - Robin Hood

Alors que Rob se retrouve à la tête d'une bande de rebelles hors-la-loi, Marianne infiltre le pouvoir à la cour. Tous deux s'efforcent de contrecarrer la corruption royale et d'apporter la paix dans le pays.
cast: Jack Patten, Lauren McQueen, Sean Bean, Connie Nielsen, Lydia Peckham

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 12th-century England, Robert of Locksley rises from grief to rebellion. With Marian at his side and outlaws at his back, Rob defies the Sheriff of Nottingham and Norman rule. His fight for freedom will give birth to the legend of Robin Hood.

Avec son frère et ses amis, elle apprend à maîtriser ce nouveau pouvoir. Alors que ses pouvoirs se renforcent, elle devient une héroïne qui se bat contre la violence et l’injustice qui minent son quartier.

Alors que les membres de l'équipe dépêchée pour récupérer l'épave recherchent des survivants, ils rencontrent des formes de vie prédatrices absolument terrifiantes. Face à cette nouvelle menace, l'équipe doit se battre pour survivre et faire des choix qui pourraient changer la Terre à jamais.

seasons.name: Season 1

name: FR - Bad Influencer

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Nothing changes overnight. No matter how hard the four pals try to do things right, they always find new ways to mess up in work, family and sex.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: As lost as ever, the four friends get tangled up in more complications as they navigate paternity, romantic anarchy and sex in a new era of masculinity.

name: FR - Respira

cast: Manu Ríos, Borja Luna, Blanca Suárez, Najwa Nimri, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Joaquín Sorolla is much more than a public hospital in Valencia where lives are saved on a daily basis. Doctors and residents work hard in the frenetic pace of the emergency room, where tensions, emotions and even desire accelerate the hearts of a staff who live increasingly on the edge. The arrival of a distinguished patient highlights the complicated situation of the public health system, lighting the fuse for what is to become an unprecedented and drastic strike.

name: AR - الضارية
plot: وفاء لوصية والده، يدخل يوسف عالم تهريب المخدرات ويعلو سريعا نحو القمة... لكن سرعان ما ينهار نجاحه حين يصطدم بزعيم أسلحة، وضابط لا يلين، وأقارب جشعين في لعبة بقاء مميتة.
cast: Fayez Bin Jurays, خالد صقر, تركي اليوسف, ريم الحبيب, آيدا القصي

name: AR - ورد وشوكولاتة
plot: مروة، إعلامية شهيرة تقدم برنامجاً على إحدى القنوات الفضائية، وتُعرف بأسلوبها الصادم وصوتها العالي في كشف القضايا الجريئة. تلتقي خلال إحدى حلقاتها بمحامٍ نافذ يُدعى صلاح، ويتسبب لقاؤهما في تغيير حياتها جذريا، إذ تقع في حبه رغم ماضيه الغامض وحياته المعقدة، ما يضعها في صراع بين قلبها وعقلها، لتصدم لاحقا برغبته بتركها والرجوع لعائلته. تبدأ رحلة مروة في كشف الحقائق، وصراعات بين الحب والسيطرة والخداع.
cast: محمد فراج, زينة, مريم الخشت, صفاء الطوخي, عمرو مهدي

seasons.name: Season 1

A single spark pulls her into a world where personal feelings collide with public pressure. As the spotlight intensifies and power games escalate, she must decide how far she’ll go - and whom she can trust - without losing her voice.

plot: Theo multiplie les plans louches pour récupérer sa voiture à la fourrière, tandis que son père mourant est prêt à tout pour obtenir un nouveau rein.
cast: Nathan Saidden, Theodore Saidden

name: FR - Hell's Kitchen
plot: Hell's Kitchen (en français la cuisine de l'enfer ou cuisine infernale) est une compétition américaine  de cuisine télévisée réelle basée sur la série britannique du même nom diffusée sur Fox. Elle est présentée par Gordon Ramsay. Deux équipes de chefs concourent pour un poste de chef dans un restaurant....
cast: Gordon Ramsay

seasons.name: All Stars
seasons.overview: Chef Ramsay invites 16 all-stars back to the kitchen for a second chance to prove they have what it takes.

seasons.name: Rookies vs Veterans
seasons.overview: Season eighteen returns with a new twist: pitting veteran contestants against rookies. For the first time, eight accomplished chefs who have competed in previous seasons – and lost – will be brought back for a shot at redemption. But these veterans will need to go up against eight ambitious rookies who are equally eager to show Chef Ramsay they have what it takes to be the next Hell's Kitchen winner and become Head Chef at the world’s first Gordon Ramsay Hell’s Kitchen Restaurant at Caesars Palace Las Vegas.

seasons.name: Las Vegas
seasons.overview: Season 19 takes place at the Hell's Kitchen restaurant in Caesars Palace in Las Vegas. The prize is a head chef's position at Gordon Ramsay Hell's Kitchen Lake Tahoe.

seasons.name: Young Guns
seasons.overview: Eighteen chefs competed in season 20, with all of them being aged 24 years old or younger.

seasons.name: Battle of the Ages
seasons.overview: Tried and true meets hungry and new.

seasons.name: The American Dream
seasons.overview: Gordon Ramsay returns for Season 22 of "Hell's Kitchen." Specially themed "The American Dream," this season focuses on uniquely American stories to test contestants and push them to their limits.

seasons.name: Head Chefs Only
seasons.overview: Chef Ramsay is focusing his search on one specific group: Head Chefs Only! This talented crop of chefs will come from all ages, backgrounds, culinary specialties, and restaurant types. But whether that restaurant is a tiny mom-and-pop shop or sports a large fine-dining brigade, these chefs are used to calling the shots. Line cooks need not apply. And with such proven leaders in his kitchen, Chef Ramsay is setting the bar higher than ever before. The challenges...tougher. The opinions...stronger. The drama...louder. These alpha head chefs will battle it out in the ultimate ego blender to prove they have the culinary skills and leadership mettle to command Chef Ramsay’s kitchen.

name: FR - Des vivants
plot: Marie, Caroline, Sébastien, Arnaud, Grégory, Stéphane et David forment le groupe des autoproclamés "Potages" (contraction de "potes" et "otages"). Le soir du 13 novembre 2015, ils ont fait face aux terroristes pendant plus de deux heures dans un étroit couloir du Bataclan. De leur survie miraculeuse est né un lien unique et indéfectible.
cast: Alix Poisson, Benjamin Lavernhe, Antoine Reinartz, Félix Moati, Anne Steffens

name: FR - Papa a Problèmes

cast: Aimee Lou Wood, David Morrissey, David Fynn, Sharon Rooney, Sarah Hadland

seasons.overview: A college student navigates life and school while dealing with a unique predicament — he's living with a beautiful former K-pop idol.

cast: Emma Thompson, Ruth Wilson, Adeel Akhtar, Nathan Stewart-Jarrett, Tom Goodman-Hill

name: EAR - Rulers of Fortune
plot: A young man aspires to rise through the ranks of Rio's gambling underworld — unaware of the dangerous game of betrayal, lust and blood that awaits him.
cast: Xamã, Juliana Paes, André Lamoglia, Mel Maia, Giullia Buscacio

name: AR - كارثة طبيعية

cast: محمد سلام, جهاد حسام الدين, كمال أبو رية, فارس الحداد, حمزة العيلي

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Mohamed and Shrouq's lives are turned upside down due to a rare, unusual pregnancy.

name: FR - The Asset (2025)
plot: Pour infiltrer un réseau criminel, une jeune policière se lie d'amitié avec la femme d'un narcotrafiquant. Mais plus elle se rapproche de sa cible, plus sa mission se complique.
cast: Clara Dessau, Maria Cordsen, Afshin Firouzi, Nicolas Bro

name: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987)
plot: Les Tortues Ninja sont quatre petites tortues qui deviennent humanoïdes, à la suite d'un contact avec une étrange substance chimique rose, le mutagène. Splinter, un maître en arts martiaux transformé en rat à la suite d'une mutation similaire, va les accueillir dans les égouts de la ville de New York et leur enseigner le Ninjutsu, l'art des ninjas. Ils vont ensuite faire la rencontre d'une journaliste nommée April O'Neil, qui va les aider à lutter contre la bande de Shredder, un méchant qui se cache derrière un masque de fer.
cast: Cam Clarke, Barry Gordon, Townsend Coleman, Michael Gough, Peter Renaday

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: Lord Dregg rises to villainy to battles the Turtles.

name: FR - Ben 10 (2005)
plot: Benjamin Tennyson est un jeune garçon âgé de 10 ans rêvant de devenir un héros dans le but d'aider son prochain. En camping, pendant ses vacances scolaires avec sa cousine Gwen (intellectuelle et future magicienne) et son grand-père Max, il découvre, dans une capsule de sauvetage spatiale écrasée sur Terre, un objet en forme de montre aux pouvoirs étranges, appelée Omnitrix, qui se fixe tout seul à son poignet. Dorénavant il peut, tout en gardant sa personnalité d'enfant, se transformer en dix extraterrestres différents aux pouvoirs surhumains. Mais cet étrange bracelet est convoité par de terribles extra-terrestres déterminés, notamment un seigneur galactique nommé Vilgax. Ainsi, le garçon se doit désormais de lutter contre des menaces bien plus dangereuses que de simples voleurs.
cast: Tara Strong, Meagan Moore, Paul Eiding

name: EAR - Down Cemetery Road
plot: When a child goes missing in the aftermath of a house explosion, a concerned neighbor teams up with a private investigator to find them. As secrets unravel and a military conspiracy emerges, all hell is unleashed on South Oxford's sleepy suburbs.
cast: Emma Thompson, Ruth Wilson, Adeel Akhtar, Nathan Stewart-Jarrett, Tom Goodman-Hill

name: AR - Passing the Reins
plot: Kurisu has always admired his father, who runs a tax accounting firm, and dreamed of working with him one day. To broaden his skills, he joined a major tax firm, but a professional setback left him disillusioned. His life takes an unexpected turn when he meets racehorse owner Sanno Kozo, reigniting his sense of purpose.
cast: Satoshi Tsumabuki, Koichi Sato, Wakana Matsumoto, Hitomi Kuroki, Kotaro Koizumi

name: FR - 100 % physique : Asie

cast: Robert Whittaker, Dominic Di Tommaso, Eloni Vunakece, Katelin van Zyl, Eddie Williams

name: FR - Surviving Summer

name: FR - Les Mystères de l'Ouest

L'un est homme d'action et homme à femme ; l'autre est inventeur et spécialiste du déguisement. Ce duo de choc a pour grand ennemi le Dr. Loveless, expert en création d'engins destructeurs.
cast: Robert Conrad, Ross Martin

name: EAR - IT: Welcome to Derry
plot: In 1962, a couple with their son move to Derry, Maine just as a young boy disappears. With their arrival, very bad things begin to happen in the town.
cast: Taylour Paige, Jovan Adepo, James Remar, Stephen Rider, Matilda Lawler

name: AR - Blood River
plot: Blood River is the realm's most feared assassin guild, jointly run by the Su, Mu, and Xie clans. They can strike royals in court and crush great sects in the wild. When the patriarch is poisoned on a mission, the three clans vie for the top seat. Su Muyu leads the Spider-Shadow unit and shields the dying leader on the road to a cure. He clashes with elder Su Zhe and old friend Su Changhe, and meets master healer Bai Hehuai. After brutal power struggles, Su Changhe becomes new patriarch and Su Muyu heads the Su clan. They launch the "Other Shore Plan" to drag Blood River out of the shadow and forge a new destiny, free from being anyone's blade.
cast: Gong Jun, Peng Xiaoran, Chang Huasen, Yang Yutong, Kong Xueer

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When the head of a cabal of assassins falls ill, his swordsman asks a divine doctor for help while fending off the three families vying for power.

name: AR - Sword and Beloved
plot: The drama series revolves around Wangquan Fugui, who is trained as the ultimate demon-slayer of the Yiqi Alliance since childhood, meeting Qing Tong, a spider demon who infiltrates Wangquan Manor as a spy. Qing Tong’s presence allows Fugui to broaden his horizon and change his view on demons. Yearning for freedom, Fugui’s fervor for attaining world peace is gradually ignited. After experiencing extreme agony, he leaves Wangquan Manor with Qing Tong, embarking on a journey of self-enlightenment.
cast: Cheng Yi, Li Yitong, Guo Junchen, Ken Chang Tzu-Yao, Tan Kai

name: EAR - The Ridge
plot: Mia is fleeing addiction and leaving behind a professional life in tatters in Scotland. She accepts a wedding invitation from her estranged sister in New Zealand – only to find the would-be-bride dead upon arrival. Caught up in grief and pulled by a dark attraction to her late-sister's fiancé Ewan, Mia soon finds that familiarity among a small community breeds secrets and tensions, endangering the brittle fabric of the town itself.
cast: Lauren Lyle, Jay Ryan, Caleb Nazzer, Beth Alexander, Florence Hartigan

name: EAR - The Asset
plot: A young agent goes undercover to befriend a drug smuggler's wife. But the closer she gets to her target, the more complicated her mission becomes.
cast: Clara Dessau, Maria Cordsen, Afshin Firouzi, Nicolas Bro

name: FR - L'atout
plot: Alors que Tea infiltre un empire criminel, cette agente sous couverture se retrouve déchirée entre sa mission et son désir d'aider la petite amie d'un chef de gang à s'enfuir.
cast: Clara Dessau, Maria Cordsen, Afshin Firouzi, Nicolas Bro

name: FR - Entrepreneurs
plot: Un groupe d'entrepreneurs, fier d'avoir quitté la zone de confort, a pour ambition de changer le monde et de devenir de puissants CEO, même s'ils n'arrivent pas à vivre de leur activité. Pour y parvenir, ils se rendent tous les jours à No Comfort Zone, un espace de coworking créé par Gonzalo, un milllionnaire paresseux, et Jacobo, un gourou de l'entrepreneuriat auto-proclamé, où ils s'efforcent de donner forme à leur projet. La réalité implacable du quotidien leur fera comprendre que le monde de l'entrepreneuriat est un écran de fumée, qu'il est presque toujours plus important d'avoir de bons contacts que de bonnes idées, et qu'ils n'ont peut-être pas pris la bonne décision en abandonnant leurs boulots conventionnels.
cast: Rober Bodegas, Alberto Casado, Aura Garrido, Gonzalo de Castro, Victoria Martín

name: FR - Vargasommar
plot: Hannah Wester, officier de police à Haparanda, fait une macabre découverte lorsqu'un loup mort est retrouvé avec des restes humains dans l'estomac. Le défunt semble avoir des liens avec une violente confrontation entre gangs en Finlande. Cette découverte s'avère bientôt être la première d'une série d'événements brutaux qui ébranlent profondément la petite ville frontalière.
cast: Eva Melander, Eliot Sumner, Henrik Dorsin, Amed Bozan, Nora Bredefeldt

name: FR - The Chosen Adventures
plot: Abby, 9 ans, et son ami Joshua rencontrent Jésus à Capharnaüm, vers l'an 30 de notre ère. Abby est pleine de questions et cherche des réponses. Leur rencontre avec Jésus pourrait tout changer.
cast: Paul Walter Hauser, Yvonne Orji, Romy Fay, Jude Zarzaur, Danny Nucci

name: FR - The Forsytes [VOSTFR]
plot: Le désir, l’ambition et la trahison traversent les générations chez les Forsyte, une famille aisée de courtiers en bourse, dont les membres, pris entre la tradition et la loyauté familiale, s’opposent souvent à leur propre quête de bonheur. Au fil des années, les tensions grandissent entre ceux qui sacrifient leurs sentiments pour préserver l’ordre établi et ceux qui osent poursuivre l’amour, quitte à briser les liens du sang et les conventions sociales.
cast: Francesca Annis, Stephen Moyer, Danny Griffin, Tuppence Middleton, Jack Davenport

name: FR - Boots
plot: In 1990, a bullied, gay high school student named Cameron joins the Marine Corps with his straight best friend, Ray — a dangerous move when being gay in the military meant jail time or worse. As these two friends plunge into Marine Corps boot camp, where the landmines are both literal and metaphorical, they join a platoon of young men on a harrowing journey of transformation.
cast: Miles Heizer, Ana Ayora, Blake Burt, Cedrick Cooper, Dominic Goodman

name: FR - Talamasca: The Secret Order [VOSTFR]
plot: Guy Anatole joins the clandestine world of the Talamasca, an international spy agency for the immortal universe, as he searches for answers to his family's own part in the supernatural world.
cast: Nicholas Denton, Celine Buckens, Maisie Richardson-Sellers, William Fichtner, Elizabeth McGovern

name: AR - The Dream Life of Mr. Kim
plot: Kim Nak-su is a middle-aged man who loses everything he once considered valuable in an instant. After a long journey, he finally discovers his true self, beyond his role as a department manager at a large corporation.
cast: Ryu Seung-ryong, Myung Se-bin, Cha Kang-yoon, Jung Eun-chae

name: FR - Le Code du crime
plot: Pour mener à bien leur enquête sur un cambriolage défiant toute mesure, des agents fédéraux doivent se montrer créatifs.
cast: Maeve Jinkings, Rômulo Braga, Thomás Aquino, Alex Nader

name: FR - The Hunting party
plot: Une petite équipe d'enquêteurs est constituée pour traquer et capturer les tueurs les plus dangereux que notre pays ait jamais connus, qui viennent tous de s'échapper d'une prison ultrasecrète qui n'est pas censée exister.
cast: Melissa Roxburgh, Nick Wechsler, Patrick Sabongui, Josh McKenzie, Sara Alicia Garcia

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a secret prison suffers a mysterious explosion that allows the nation's most violent serial killers to escape, a former profiler is thrust back into a thrilling game of cat and mouse. Alongside a team of soldiers, spies and special agents, she has no choice but to track down and recapture these dangerous criminals… before they kill again.

name: EAR - Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars
plot: Experience thrilling highs and crushing lows as the world's best chefs pursue the ultimate accolade: a Michelin Star. These anonymous inspectors have never let anyone in on their mysterious ways, until now.
cast: Jesse Burgess

name: TAR - أنا أمها
plot: عائشة تخرج من السجن بعد سنوات من الاتهام بقتل زوجها، وهدفها الوحيد هو لقاء ابنتها زينب التي فقدتها منذ زمن. لكن زينب لا تعرفها، فقد تبناها رجل يُدعى كمال. لتقترب من ابنتها، على عائشة أن تكسب ثقة كمال وقلبه، بينما تقف في طريقها حماتها السابقة سونا التي تتهمها بموت ابنها وتسعى للانتقام منها.
cast: فوندا إريجيت, Caner Cindoruk, Zerrin Tekindor, Azra Aksu

name: FR - Côte Ouest (1979)
plot: Après 17 ans de séparation, Gary Ewing et son ex-femme Valene ont décidé de reprendre la vie commune. Ils partent se fixer loin de Dallas dans une résidence proche de la mer à Knots Landing, en Californie. A peine installés dans leur nouvelle demeure, ils font la connaissance de leurs voisins, les Fairgate et les Avery. La petite communauté mène une vie plus ou moins paisible... jusqu'à l'arrivée de l'intrigante Abby Fairgate !
cast: Michele Lee, Ted Shackelford, Kevin Dobson, William Devane, Nicollette Sheridan

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a seaside suburban paradise, four married couples struggle with the conflicts and passions that buffet every marriage.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Adultery, rape and white-collar crime plague the families of seaside Knots Landing--with lethal consequences.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Passions escalate as four couples battle temptation in a seaside suburban paradise.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Lust, alcoholism and murder strike, causing further turmoil in the suburban cul-de-sac.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: William Devane joins the cast as the residents of Knots landing cope with a corrupt land-development deal, adultery, unwanted pregnancy and a Central American civil war.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Alec Baldwin joins the cast. Control of the Ewing fortune rests on the fate of illegitimate twin babies--and the residents of Knots Landing resort to blackmail, kidnapping and murder.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: The residents of an idyllic seaside cul-de-sac face an ongoing feud over a corrupt land development deal and the supposed suicide of one of them. Ava Gardner joins the cast.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: Power struggles over politics, money and sex rock the idyllic seaside community of Knots Landing.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: From the discovery of a body buried in concrete to gun-running and murder over sexual jealousy, multiple crises shatter the peace in the cul-de-sac.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: Financial schemes, intrigue, murder and lust culminate in the possible expulsion from the cul-de-sac of one of the neighbors.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: Love and new relationships interweave with insidious plots, adultery and death as a serial murderer insinuates himself among the residents of the cul-de-sac.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: As two residents of the cul-de-sac confront mortality, the others living in Knots Landing continue to plot and scheme--and face surprising reversals of fortune.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: Passion, sex and violence buffet the small, seaside community of Knots Landing.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: After fourteen years of lust, greed and betrayal, passions explode in this final season of "Knots Landing."

name: FR - Top Guns: The Next Generation
plot:
Dans le monde palpitant et compétitif de la formation de pilotes de chasse de l’U.S. Navy, seuls les plus forts s’en sortent. Nous avons filmé en exclusivité les coulisses des derniers six mois exténuants de l’entraînement et de la sélection, où les élèves apprennent à voler en situations de combat.

Leur rêve de décrocher leurs ailes de pilotes se heurte à la dure réalité des exercices. Nous serons avec eux dans le cockpit pendant ces exercices conçus pour repousser leurs limites. Ils ne réussiront pas tous.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Go beyond the cockpit to follow ambitious young Navy and Marine students both in the air and off-base, capturing candid moments with family and friends and revealing the personal stakes, sacrifices and motivations that brought them here. Filmed with unprecedented access, the series immerses audiences in a world of intense pressure and soaring expectations, where dreams of earning wings of gold collide with the harsh reality of the grueling training. From bombing drills to close-range dogfights and nail-biting carrier approaches, each episode captures the intense demands of a program that challenges their abilities, endurance and resolve at every turn.

name: FR - Allen Iv3rson [VOSTFR]
plot: ALLEN IV3RSON raconte l'histoire de la légende de la NBA. Cette docu-série dévoile des images inédites et des interviews exclusives pour illustrer son ascension, d'une enfance marquée par la pauvreté à l'icône culturelle, avec ses sacrifices, sa résilience et sa loyauté sans faille envers sa famille et sa communauté, montrant comment il a redéfini le jeu et inspiré les générations à venir.
cast: Allen Iverson

name: EAR - Death in Apartment 603: What Happened to Ellen Greenberg?
plot: Explore the death of Ellen Greenberg, officially ruled a suicide but her parents have insisted she was murdered and the pathologist who ruled her death a suicide recently changed his mind.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Exploring the death of Ellen Greenberg, initially ruled a suicide; her family insists she was murdered.

name: EAR - Entrepreneurs
plot: Gonzalo, a bar owner's son, keeps failing at nightlife ventures funded by his father. Given one last chance with a new space, he partners with a self-proclaimed guru to open a coworking space, supervised by his sister Julia.
cast: Rober Bodegas, Alberto Casado, Aura Garrido, Gonzalo de Castro, Victoria Martín

name: EAR - In the Eye of the Storm
plot: This series reveals recent natural disasters as they happened in real-time through footage captured by eyewitnesses who found themselves in the wrong place at the right time and boldly held up their camera phones to capture the eye of the storm.
cast: Reed Timmer

plot: An epic 18-day battle unfolds through the perspectives of 18 warriors, revealing their inner struggles and ethical challenges during a war between brothers.
cast: Vinod Sharma, Sahil Vaid, Saumya Daan, Anamaya Verma

name: EAR - Lazarus 2025
plot: يجد الطبيب النفسي الجنائي (جويل لاز لازاروس) نفسه مجبراً على مواجهة أحزانه بعد وفاة والده (إل) في ظروف غامضة. ورغم اقتناعه في البداية بأن الانتحار هو التفسير الوحيد، تبدأ الحقائق بالتكشف فتدفعه إلى الانغماس في شبكة من المؤامرات المظلمة.

name: EAR - Mob War: Philadelphia vs. the Mafia
plot: Philadelphia is the City of Brotherly Love, but in the '90s, it was a bloodbath. Two warring mob factions battle for control in this true-crime series.
cast: John Alite, Charlotte Lang, Angelo Lutz, Barry Gross, Stephen Lapenta

name: EAR - The Monster of Florence
plot: As a serial killer targets couples and strikes terror in Italy, authorities explore a case from 1968 that may be key to finding The Monster of Florence.
cast: Marco Bullitta, Valentino Mannias, Francesca Olia, Liliana Bottone, Giacomo Fadda

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: Eight double murders. 17 years of terror. Always the same weapon: a .22 caliber Beretta. In Italy, a faceless serial killer sows panic, sparking one of the longest and most complex investigations ever.T

name: AR - Just a bit Espers
plot: A down-and-out salaryman, fired and divorced, lands a bizarre job requiring him to fake a marriage with a stranger to save the world.
cast: Yo Oizumi, Aoi Miyazaki, Dean Fujioka, Takumi Kitamura, Atsuko Takahata

name: AR - Shin's Project
plot: في بلدة صغيرة، يدير "شين" مطعماً بسيطاً للدجاج المقلي، لكن خلف هذه الواجهة الهادئة يكمن رجل ذو ماضٍ غامض. "شين" هو وسيط قضايا خاسرة، يدافع عن أناس على وشك الانهيار فرصتهم في الفوز صفر. يجد نفسه في صراع دائم مع الأشرار، متسلحاً فقط بلسانه السليط وقبضتيه. وعلى الرغم من أنه يحاول جاهداً أن يعيش في سلام ويتجاهل مشاكل الآخرين، إلا أن الأقدار تجبره على التدخل وحل القضايا من حوله واحدة تلو الأخرى.
cast: 한석규, 배현성, 이레, 김성오, 우미화

name: TAR - قلب أسود مدبلج
plot:
سمرو امرأة قررت ترك توأميها في سن مبكرة والتي تزوجت فيما بعد من رجل الأعمال الثري سامت.

يكتشف التوأمان نوح ومليك هوية والدتهما الحقيقية ويقررون السفر إلى كابادوكيا للقاء أفراد العائلة الجديدة.

على الرغم من محاولات سمرو المستميتة لإبعاد أبنائها عنها يتمكن نوح ومليك من بناء علاقات قوية مع جيهان وسيفيلاي أفراد العائلة الجديدة وينجحان في كسب قلوبهما.
cast: Ece Uslu, Burak Sergen, Burak Tozkoparan, Leyla Tanlar, Hafsanur Sancaktutan

name: FR - King of Boys : The Return of the King
plot: Alhaja Enola Salami recommence, jetant son dévolu sur une autre position de pouvoir, alimentée par la vengeance, le regret et la cruauté.
cast: Lord Frank, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Osas Ighodaro, Sola Sobowale, Remilekun Reminisce Safaru

cast: Mitsuhiro Oikawa, Yuya Tegoshi, Tamaki Shiratori, Naoki Tanaka, Shibuya Nagisa

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A clumsy romantic, an aloof teacher and a troubled teen cross paths, forming an unlikely household in this offbeat comedy about love and belonging.

cast: Sam Claflin, Bill Nighy, Alexandra Roach, David Fynn, Karla Crome

name: FR - Le Monstre de Florence
plot: Retour sur l'affaire non résolue du tueur en série le "Monstre de Florence", auteur de neuf doubles meurtres entre 1968 et 1985. Malgré les enquêtes, l'arme utilisée pour chaque meurtre - un Beretta de calibre 22 - n'a jamais été retrouvée et le tueur n'a jamais été arrêté.
cast: Liliana Bottone, Giacomo Fadda, Francesca Olia, Marco Bullitta, Valentino Mannias

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: Eight double murders. 17 years of terror. Always the same weapon: a .22 caliber Beretta. In Italy, a faceless serial killer sows panic, sparking one of the longest and most complex investigations ever.T

name: FR - Murder in a Small Town
plot: Karl Alberg est un détective qui s'installe dans une paisible ville côtière pour apaiser un psychisme mis à mal par le travail de la police des grandes villes, mais ce doux paradis a plus que sa part de secrets, et Karl devra faire appel à toutes les compétences dont il a besoin. a fait de lui un détective de classe mondiale pour résoudre les meurtres qui, même dans ce cadre apparemment idyllique, continuent de s'échouer sur ses côtes.
cast: Rossif Sutherland, Kristin Kreuk, Aaron Douglas

name: FR - La famille Rose
plot: En France, de nos jours. Les Rose - Diane la mère, Bernard le père, Lou l’adolescente et Noé le petit dernier - sont une famille ordinaire, avec leurs problèmes ordinaires : le couple bat de l’aile, l’ado rêve d’émancipation et le plus petit a du mal à trouver sa place. Quand leur van tombe en panne à proximité d’un village à première vue tranquille, leur arrivée provoque la réouverture d’une enquête sur une disparition 7 ans auparavant, un fait divers auquel les Rose ne sont pas totalement étrangers. Tandis qu’ils cherchent désespérément à protéger leur secret, leurs liens familiaux sont mis à rude épreuve. Le village est un piège mortel où les chasseurs pourraient vite devenir les proies.
cast: Shirine Boutella, Arthur Dupont, Capucine Valmary, Lou-Adriana Bouziouane, Gaspard Meier-Chaurand

name: FR - The Deal
plot: Genève, avril 2015. Des négociations internationales sous haute tension s’ouvrent entre les USA et l’Iran, soupçonné de développer en secret l’arme atomique. Alexandra Weiss, cheffe de la mission diplomatique suisse, tente de maintenir un équilibre fragile entre les parties qui manœuvrent en coulisse. L’arrivée inattendue de son ancien amour, Payam Sanjabi, un ingénieur iranien dont la vie est menacée, va lui compliquer dangereusement la tâche…
cast: Veerle Baetens, Arash Marandi, Juliet Stevenson, Anthony Azizi, Alexander Behrang Keshtkar

name: FR - Sheriff Country [VOSTFR]
plot: Le shérif Mickey Fox enquête sur des activités criminelles et patrouille les rues de la petite ville d'Edgewater tout en affrontant son père, ancien détenu, et un mystérieux incident impliquant sa fille rebelle.
cast: Morena Baccarin, W. Earl Brown, Christopher Gorham, Michele Weaver, Matt Lauria

name: FR - My Youth [VOSTFR]
plot: The story of Sun Woo-hae and Sung Je-yun, who reunite after 15 years, struggling and living fiercely in their respective stages.
cast: Song Joong-ki, Chun Woo-hee, Lee Ju-myoung, Seo Ji-hoon, Jin Kyung

name: FR - Les Pierrafeu
plot: Tout se passe à l'âge de la pierre dans une ville appelée Saint-Granit (Bedrock), mais où la société est exactement la même que celle des États-Unis dans la deuxième moitié du XXe siècle. C’est une version fantaisiste de la préhistoire où des dinosaures, des ptérodactyles, des tigres à dents de sabre, des mammouths laineux et d'autres animaux disparus depuis longtemps coexistent avec des hommes des cavernes, qui emploient une technologie équivalente à celle du XXe siècle en se servant surtout de divers animaux comme outils.
cast: Alan Reed, Mel Blanc, Jean Vander Pyl, Gerry Johnson, Don Messick

name: AR - Chosen Home

cast: Masaki Suda, Fumi Nikaido, Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe

name: EAR - Anne Rice's Talamasca: The Secret Order
plot: Guy Anatole falls headlong into a world of secret agents and immortal beings who, up to now, have maintained a fragile balance with the mortal world.
cast: Nicholas Denton, William Fichtner, Elizabeth McGovern, Maisie Richardson-Sellers, Celine Buckens

cast: David Mitchell, Anna Maxwell Martin, Dipo Ola, Gerran Howell, Izuka Hoyle

cast: Joe Cappa

cast: Kanna Ravi, Sanjeev, Sravnitha Srikanth, Vinusha Devi, Rekha Nair

name: EAR - Hollywood Hustler: Glitz, Glam, Scam
plot: The meteoric rise and catastrophic fall of Zach Horowitz, a wannabe actor, on his journey from Indiana to Los Angeles as he orchestrates one of Hollywood's most audacious financial frauds. Obsessed with achieving A-list status despite his limited talent on screen, Zach convinces his university friends with finance backgrounds to join his business ventures with fabricated backings from powerful CEOs.

name: AR - Typhoon Family
plot: Depicts the struggles of small and medium-sized businesses and their families who face the 1997 IMF crisis head-on.
cast: Lee Jun-ho, Kim Min-ha, Kim Ji-young, Kim Min-seok, Moo Jin-sung

name: TAR - المحتالون
plot: يطلب المحامي المرموق إرتان، الذي يعمل إلى جانب والده، مساعدة امرأة ماهرة في التلاعب والخداع تُدعى “آسيا” (كانت قد رُزمت قصّتها مع الفقر)، ليُنجز قضية حرجة تخص رجل الأعمال القوي هِدايت كوتمن. هذا التعاون غير المتوقع يجرّهما إلى شبكة معقدة من الأسرار، الخداع، الصراعات العائلية، والتحالفات المضللة، حيث لا أحد يُظهر الحقيقة كاملة.
cast: Hilal Altınbilek, Burak Deniz, Haluk Bilginer, Tamer Levent, Perihan Savaş

name: EAR - Boston Blue
plot: NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a job with the Boston PD and is paired with Detective Lena Silver, part of a law enforcement family comprised of District Attorney Mae Silver, Police Superintendent Sarah Silver, rookie cop Jonah Silver and Rev. Edwin Peters. Reagan hopes to reconnect with his son, Sean, in Boston.
cast: Donnie Wahlberg, Sonequa Martin-Green, Ernie Hudson, Maggie Lawson, Gloria Reuben

name: EAR - The Lost Station Girls
plot: Between 1995 and 2001 in southern France, a teenage girl vanishes and three young women are murdered—sparking a relentless manhunt that will haunt detective Flore Robin and the Perpignan police for years.
cast: Hugo Becker, Patrick Timsit, Mélanie Doutey, Kévin Azaïs, Camille Razat

name: FR - For Life
plot: Accusé à tort de meurtre et envoyé en prison à vie, Aaron devient avocat depuis sa cellule et se sert de sa nouvelle occupation pour aider ses compagnons, mais aussi pour prouver son innocence. Sa quête de liberté est motivée par son désir de retrouver sa famille et de récupérer la vie qui lui a été arrachée. Injustement condamné, le détenu va devoir se heurter aux limites du système judiciaire.
cast: Nicholas Pinnock, Indira Varma, Joy Bryant, Dorian Missick, Tyla Harris

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Facing a life sentence in prison for a crime he didn’t commit, a man becomes a lawyer to seek justice and defend others who have been wrongfully accused.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Embarking on a new chapter, prisoner-turned-lawyer Aaron Wallace discovers his fight for justice is far from over.

name: FR - Galactik Football
plot: Cette série met en scène l'histoire d'une jeune équipe de football futuriste, les Snow Kids, qui va essayer de gagner la Galactik Football Cup pour leur planète Akillian, après s'être faite recruter par une ancienne légende du football. Mais pour ce faire, ils devront faire face à de nombreuses équipes bien plus aguerries que la leur comme les Shadows, les Lightnings ou les Wambas, et devront s'imposer comme la meilleure équipe. On suit alors leurs débuts de joueurs, de l'anonymat à la célébrité et leur évolution aussi bien dans le football que dans leur vie privée.
cast: Florence Dumortier, Fréderic Popovic, Yann Pichon, Isabelle Volpe, Emmanuel Gradi

name: EAR - Sheriff Country
plot: Mickey Fox investigates criminal activity and patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.

name: EAR - 9-1-1: Nashville

Joni, devenue psychologue pour enfants, retourne dans sa ville natale pour affronter les fantômes de son passé et découvrir la vérité derrière la disparition de sa meilleure amie. name: FR - Les Disparues de la gare

Leurs visages s’affichent dans les journaux. Elles deviennent "les Disparues de la Gare". Flore Robin, jeune enquêtrice, fait ses premiers pas dans la police le jour même où le premier corps est retrouvé. Elle devra faire équipe avec le capitaine de police Franck Vidal et son mentor Felix Sabueso, longtemps mis au placard, mais rappelé spécialement pour cette affaire hors normes. Parallèlement, la mère de la jeune fille portée disparue, explore chaque piste pour retrouver sa fille. Pendant 20 ans, alors qu’une véritable psychose s’abat peu à peu sur la ville, la traque d’un tueur en série impitoyable mais introuvable fait rage.

name: FR - Monstre : L'Histoire d'Ed Gein

seasons.name: Miniseries
seasons.overview: Serial killer. Grave robber. Psycho. In the frozen fields of 1950s rural Wisconsin, a friendly, mild-mannered recluse named Eddie Gein lived quietly on a decaying farm - hiding a house of horrors so gruesome it would redefine the American nightmare. Driven by isolation, psychosis, and an all-consuming obsession with his mother, Gein's perverse crimes birthed a new kind of monster that would haunt Hollywood for decades. From Psycho to The Texas Chainsaw Massacre to The Silence of the Lambs, Gein's macabre legacy gave birth to fictional monsters born in his image and ignited a cultural obsession with the criminally deviant. Ed Gein didn't just influence a genre -- he became the blueprint for modern horror.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Chad Powers is a superstar on the field but his odd behavior off it has everyone suspicious - especially Coach Hudson and Gerry. The walls are closing in on Russ's lie, and if he and Danny want Chad to survive the regular season and lead the Catfish to the College Football Playoff, the only person who can help them is the last person who wants to: Ricky.

name: AR - راحوا
plot: من خلال قصة حقيقية وقعت، تدور أحداث المسلسل حول حادث مأساوي باقتحام أحد المطاعم في ليلة رأس السنة وتنفيذ عملية قتل جماعي، ووقوع عدد كبير من الضحايا بين مصابين وقتلة.
cast: Kareen Rezq Allah, بديع أبو شقرا, Joseph Bou Nassar, نهلة عقل داوود

name: FR - Chad Powers
plot: Huit ans après avoir mis fin à une carrière prometteuse à cause d’une erreur impardonnable, le quarterback Russ Holliday tente de la ressusciter. Il se déguise alors en Chad Powers, un original talentueux qui rejoint l’équipe des South Georgia Catfish.
cast: Glen Powell, Steve Zahn, Perry Mattfeld, Frankie A. Rodriguez, Quentin Plair

name: FR - Hawaii 5-0
plot: Le détective Steve McGarrett se rend à Oahu pour enquêter sur l'assassinat de son père. Une fois sur place, le gouverneur le persuade de rester et rejoindre l'unité des forces spéciales, qui combat le crime à Hawaii...
cast: Alex O'Loughlin, Scott Caan, Ian Anthony Dale, Meaghan Rath, Beulah Koale

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: As Season 2 begins, McGarrett is in jail awaiting trial and Danny comes to visit him with a special guest. Danny finds out that Rachel's intentions may be different than he was hoping for. The task force gets a new team member whose job is to keep them in line.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The third season of Hawaii Five-0 picks up where season two left off, with Chin Ho being forced to choose between saving his wife or his cousin. McGarrett escorts his mother back to Hawaii and realizes she is in danger but question whether his mother may be keeping from him. Meanwhile, the team turns to ex-con and art expert August March to help hunt down a group of thieves.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Picking up where Season 3 left off, we find McGarrett and Wo Fat cornered by unknown assailants in a detainment facility in season 4 of Hawaii Five-0, forcing McGarrett to break the law and turn on his own in order to find a kidnapped Catherine. Meanwhile Kono and Adam's secret location in Hong Kong is compromised, and Kono and Adam fight to stay alive when their hidden location is discovered.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: In the 5th season of Hawaii Five-0, McGarrett continues to try to bring closure to his father's case and closure to his mother's past, while the state's brash Five-O unit, who may spar and jest among themselves, remain determined to eliminate the seedy elements from the 50th state.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Hawaii Five-0 continues to wipe out the crime that washes up on the Islands' sun-drenched beaches in its 6th season. McGarrett and his team take on cases including a murder that leads to a centuries old lost pirate treasure, a copycat arsonist calling for the release of a murderous prisoner, and the unceasing hunt for Gabriel Waincroft.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: In the season premiere, McGarrett refuses to listen to Danny's pleas to take it easy while recovering from surgery after the body of a serial killer is left in the Five-0 headquarters with an ivory chess piece in his mouth.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: McGarrett, Danno and the Five-0 task force continue to wipe out the crime that washes up on the islands’ sun-drenched beaches, and this year are joined by new and old friends to help in their mission. Whether dealing with an infamous pyromaniac loose in the jungle, a devious black-hat hacker, stopping the dangerous Yakuza crime syndicate or planning to open a very bro-mantic restaurant, Five-0 continues to protect their loved ones, Hawaii’s citizens and visitors to the 50th state.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: McGarrett, Danno and the Five-0 task force continue to wipe out the crime that washes up on the islands' sun-drenched beaches, and this year are joined by new and old friends to help in their mission.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: The 10th season finds McGarrett and Five-0 reeling from the shots fired in HQ and who on the team was hit.

name: FR - Montmartre
plot: Paris, 1899. Céleste, danseuse de Cancan dans un cabaret de Montmartre, tente désespérément de retrouver le frère et la soeur dont elle a été séparée brutalement enfant quand leur père a été assassiné sous leurs yeux. Pour pouvoir payer Léon, l’inspecteur chargé de les retrouver, elle n’a d’autre choix que de danser nue.  Elle devient ainsi la première effeuilleuse de Paris et fait scandale bien malgré elle. De spectacle en spectacle, à mesure qu’elle prend de l’assurance, une nouvelle vie s’offre à elle mais les démons de son passé ne cessent de la rattraper.
cast: Alice Dufour, Victor Meutelet, Claire Romain, Hugo Becker, Mathilde Seigner

name: FR - Les Désastreuses Aventures des orphelins Baudelaire

name: FR - Universal Basic Guys

Ils reçoivent alors trois mille dollars par mois dans le cadre d'un nouveau programme de revenu de base, et utilisent leur temps libre et l’argent donné pour se trouver un but, dans un monde où l'on n'a plus besoin d'eux.
cast: Adam Malamut, Craig Malamut, Talia Genevieve, Fred Armisen

name: AR - Love's Ambition
plot: Renowned anchor Xu Yan and urban elite Shen Haoming appear to be the perfect couple but struggle to fit into each other’s social circles due to their differing backgrounds. When conflict arises, Xu Yan leaves, prompting Shen Haoming to realize his deep love for her and attempt to win her back. On their journey, they face challenges, shed their facades, and rediscover their true selves.
cast: Zhao Lusi, William Chan, Wan Peng, Guan Zijing, Wang Yiyao

name: AR - Justice is Mine
plot: Upright and incorruptible Judge Chun Yue is forced to cover up the truth after his son causes a hit-and-run that injures the son of a notorious gang leader. Seeking vengeance for his son's injuries, the ruthless crime boss unleashes a wave of bloodshed across the city. Meanwhile, determined police officer Tong Huen remains resolute in her pursuit of justice, relentlessly chasing the truth behind the web of corruption and revenge.
cast: Nick Cheung Ka-Fai, Myolie Wu Hang-Yee, Joseph Zeng, Nina Paw Hei-Ching, Eddie Cheung Siu-Fai

name: FR - Les Enquêtes impossibles

Pierre Bellemare met son talent de conteur au service de ces histoires étranges afin de ménager suspense et mystère. L'histoire racontée est illustrée par des reconstitutions tirées du format original américain Unsolved Mysteries (1987-2002) présentée par Robert Stack (plus de 553 épisodes).
cast: Pierre Bellemare

name: FR - Signé Cat's Eyes

Alongside rookie officer Zhi An and informant Duo Zai, Yang follows a trail back to Mou Sen’s new synthetic drug operation, uncovering a complex web of drug networks. With nothing left but the will to take revenge, she turns to deepfake technology as her ultimate weapon, infiltrating a vast and merciless syndicate. Along the way, she encounters Ma Seok Gu, a ruthless boss hungry for power, Jeong Hun, a cop torn between truth and loyalty, and Do Jin, a hacker with a sinister smile. Plunging into a web of betrayal and danger with the fake identities she forges, will she exact vengeance, or will they destroy her?

name: EAR - The Lowdown

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In a world where truth lies buried beneath layers of power and deception, season 2 pushes deeper into the cost of uncovering what others are desperate to keep hidden. As new conspiracies emerge, alliances fracture, and every revelation carries dangerous consequences. Ethan Hawke leads with quiet intensity, Keith David commands every scene with authority, Ryan Kiera Armstrong delivers striking emotional depth, and Mahershala Ali brings layered gravitas—elevating each moment with tension and nuance. Dark, gripping, and intellectually charged, the second season is a high-stakes drama about truth, loyalty, and the price of digging too deep.

The series will reveal the often surprising extent of the competition between these two companies over time, and how that rivalry drove innovation and global expansion, and ultimately allowed room for the emergence of Nike.

Après qu’on lui a inoculé un sérum à l’origine mystérieuse, Gabriel se voit doté de capacités inédites. Désormais plus fort, plus rapide, plus résistant qu’un être humain normal, il intègre une unité d’élite composée de soldats augmentés : les Sentinelles. Mais il est très vite confronté à une réalité terrifiante qui risque de faire basculer le sort de la guerre.

name: EAR - Slow Horses

cast: Gary Oldman, Jack Lowden, Kristin Scott Thomas

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a young man is kidnapped and threatened with beheading, the slow horses find themselves unexpectedly embroiled in a dangerous case that forces them to prove their worth.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Long-buried Cold War secrets emerge which threaten to bring carnage to the streets of London. When a liaison with Russian villains takes a fatal turn, our hapless heroes must overcome their individual failings and raise their spy game in a race to prevent a catastrophic incident.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: A romantic liaison in Istanbul threatens to expose a buried MI5 secret in London. When Jackson Lamb and his team of misfits are dragged into the fight, they find themselves caught in a conspiracy that threatens the future not just of Slough House but of MI5 itself.

seasons.name: Season 4

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: In season five, everyone is suspicious when resident tech nerd Roddy Ho has a glamorous new girlfriend. When a series of increasingly bizarre events occur across the city, it falls to the Slow Horses to work out how everything is connected. After all, Lamb knows that in the world of espionage, the London Rules — cover your back — always apply.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: In season six, the Slow Horses are on the run as Diana Taverner embroils them all in a fatally high-stakes game of retaliation and revenge.
