cast: Steven Mackintosh, Olivia Williams, Hermione Corfield, Jamie Blackley, Edward Bluemel

name: FR - The Lawyer
plot: Frank Nordling is a young and exceptionally promising defense lawyer. When Frank learns the truth behind his parents' death, his whole world unravels. As children, Frank and his sister Sara witnessed their parents die in an explosion caused by a car bomb. As Frank finds out, they were murdered by one of the leaders in Copenhagen's criminal underworld, Thomas Waldman. In order to avenge his parents Frank must infiltrate Waldman's organization and become his personal lawyer and trusted confidant. To avoid putting those close to him in danger, Frank has to keep up appearances and play the game. But can he handle it? Is it worth the price? And who's really tricking whom?
cast: Alexander Karim, Malin Buska, Sara Hjort Ditlevsen, Susanne Storm, Thomas Bo Larsen

name: FR - Stella Blómkvist

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Two years after the fateful events in the Cabinet, Stella Blómkvist is still tough as a lawyer. Dagbjört is the Prime Minister after a decisive election victory and we are facing a completely changed Iceland under its strong government. Stella solves a case with the help of her friends Gunna and Raggur, but before long she is sucked back into the corrupt vortex of crime and politics, where she is forced to deal with more dangerous and unscrupulous opponents than she has known before.

name: FR - Comptine mortelle
plot: L'éditrice de livres Susan Ryeland reçoit un manuscrit inachevé de l'écrivain mystère à succès Alan Conway mettant en vedette le personnage principal de longue date de Conway, le détective Atticus Pünd. Lorsqu'elle tente d'atteindre les derniers chapitres de Conway, elle se retrouve au milieu d'un cas mystérieux et choquant qui va changer sa vie d'une manière à laquelle elle ne s'attendait pas.
cast: Lesley Manville, Tim McMullan, Nia Deacon, Conleth Hill, Daniel Mays

name: FR - Le Late avec Alain Chabat
plot: Alain Chabat revient à la télévision pour animer du lundi au vendredi à 23 heures sur TF1, un late show à la française.  (diffusion du 21 Novembre au 2 Décembre 2022)
cast: Alain Chabat

name: FR - Papas à la Demande
plot: California, une jeune fille de treize ans, et ses trois parents adoptifs entreprennent un voyage de Mexico à Zacatecas afin de retrouver sa mère, dont elle est sans nouvelles depuis neuf ans. Ce qu'ils ne savent pas, c'est qu'ils sont suivis par deux drôles de voyous aux intentions suspectes.
cast: Jorge Blanco, Michael Ronda, Lalo Brito, Farah Justiniani

name: FR - Les Invisibles
plot: Darius, vif, passionné, un brin magouilleur est le boss des « Invisibles », une brigade à la marge qui gère des enquêtes sur les corps sans identité, sans histoire, sans passé…
cast: Guillaume Cramoisan, Nathalie Cerda, Déborah Krey, Quentin Faure, Cécile Rebboah

name: FR - Drôle de science
plot: Dans cette série d'anthologie de science-fiction, la curiosité mène parfois à la catastrophe. Des étudiants sont les témoins de phénomènes étranges.

name: FR - Marchlands
plot: The gripping story of three different families living in the same house in the 1960’s, 1980’s and present day. The families are linked by the spirit of a young girl – the 1960’s family’s daughter who died in mysterious circumstances.
cast: Alex Kingston, Denis Lawson, Anne Reid, Elliot Cowan, Shelley Conn

name: FR - Avatar : Le dernier maître de l'air
plot: Ang est un jeune Maître de l'Air, mais c'est surtout l'Avatar, un être unique qui maîtrise tous les éléments - Feu, Air, Eau et Terre. Lors d'un terrible orage, il sombre dans la mer et hiberne grâce à ses pouvoirs d'Avatar, pour se réveiller un siècle plus tard dans un monde tyrannisé par la puissante Nation du Feu et où il est le dernier représentant de son peuple. Aidé de ses deux amis de la Tribu de l'Eau, Ang va devoir réveiller l'Avatar en lui, apprendre à contrôler tous les éléments et se battre contre la menace que les Maîtres du Feu font peser sur le monde.
cast: Zach Tyler, Mae Whitman, Jack De Sena, Dante Basco, Michaela Jill Murphy

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: Unaired Pilot, Recaps, Specials and DVD extras.

seasons.name: Book One: Water
seasons.overview: Katara and Sokka (a brother and sister from the Southern Water Tribe) discover the Avatar (a 12-year-old Airbender boy named Aang) frozen in an iceberg. Together the three begin their journey to the North Pole to find a master waterbender so Aang can begin his Avatar training!

seasons.name: Book Two: Earth
seasons.overview: Aang, along with Katara, Sokka, and their animal friends Appa and Momo, continues on his quest to fulfill his destiny as the Avatar. According to the Avatar cycle, the group must now enter the Earth Kingdom to search for a master earthbender to teach Aang.

seasons.name: Book Three: Fire
seasons.overview: Aang wakes up from his battle with Azula to discover that Ba Sing Se has fallen and the world thinks he's dead. So he and his friends set off undercover across the Fire Nation to find Fire Lord Ozai before the Day of Black Sun. Prince Zuko returns home as the triumphant son, but soon finds the honor he so greatly craved from his father is worthless. New alliances are formed and Team Avatar forges a new plan to stop the Fire Lord. But will they find him in time?

name: FR - Avengers : l'équipe des super héros
plot:
Les 74 plus dangereux "super-vilains" s'échappent en même temps des prisons les mieux gardées du monde. Pour leur faire face, cinq des plus puissants super-héros de la Terre s'allient et forment une alliance afin de combattre le mal. Ils sont les "Avengers" !

À leur tête, on retrouve l'ingénieur Tony Stark, accompagné de l'Homme-fourmi, le dieu Thor, Hulk et Janet Van Dyne. Ils seront vite rejoints par le Capitaine America, Œil-de-Faucon et la mystérieuse Panthère noire.
cast: Eric Loomis, Brian Bloom, Rick D. Wasserman, Colleen O'Shaughnessey, Chris Cox

name: FR - Blaze and the Monster Machines
plot: AJ is an 8-year-old techie who drives monster-truck Blaze, the top racer in Axle City. The two go on adventures that have them taking on problems involving science and math. Many predicaments they face are caused by Blaze's rival, Crusher, a tractor-trailer that will do anything to beat other vehicles to the finish line. The animated series is billed as the first TV show for preschoolers to comprehensively cover areas of science, technology, engineering and math. Each episode introduces different STEM concepts, including buoyancy and trajectory.
cast: Nolan North, Kevin Michael Richardson, Nat Faxon, Sunil Malhotra, Susan Silo

name: FR - Chasseurs de Trolls : Les Contes d'Arcadia
plot: Dans cette série créée par Guillermo del Toro, un ado sans histoire se pose en véritable sauveur de l'humanité après avoir mis la main sur une mystérieuse amulette.
cast: Lexi Medrano, Charlie Saxton, Amy Landecker, Kelsey Grammer, Fred Tatasciore

name: FR - Disenchantment
plot: Set in a ruined medieval city called Dreamland, Disenchantment follows the grubby adventures of a hard-drinking princess, her feisty elf companion and her personal demon.
cast: Abbi Jacobson, Lucy Montgomery, Nat Faxon, Tress MacNeille, David Herman

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: It all endeth here. To save Dreamland from Queen Dagmar’s wicked rule, Bean must vanquish her mother and outrun a prophecy that foretells she will kill someone she loves. The stakes are as high as ever as our heroes face Satan, a headless corpse, an evil scientist, and most terrifying of all — their true destiny.

name: FR - Gigantosaurus
plot: Four curious young dinosaur friends explore the mystery of Gigantosaurus, the largest, fiercest dinosaur of all, facing their individual fears and working together to solve problems during their many adventures.
cast: Dylan Schombing, Áine Sunderland, Nahanni Mitchell, Nicholas Holmes

name: FR - Les reines de la route
plot: Sept femmes, passionnées par leur métier de chauffeur poids-lourds, partagent leur quotidien au cœur des routes de France et d'Europe. Elles parcourent des centaines de kilomètres au volant de leurs camions XXL : des 44 tonnes, les plus gros gabarits de la route. Chaque jour, elles doivent accomplir une nouvelle mission : charger d'énormes cargaisons et les livrer dans les temps. Cette course contre la montre se joue parfois dans des conditions extrêmes : neige, brouillard, problèmes mécaniques… Mais rien n'arrête nos reines de la route ! Sans jamais renoncer à leur féminité et à leur vie sentimentale et familiale, elles brisent les codes pour vivre leur amour du camion ! Plus qu'une passion, ce métier de routière est une vocation.

name: FR - À découvert
plot: Basé sur la série de livres à succès d'Harlan Coben, "À découvert" raconte l'histoire de Mickey Bolitar après la mort de son père qui le mène à commencer une nouvelle vie dans le New Jersey. Lorsqu'un nouvel élève disparaît, Mickey se retrouve mêlé à des secrets. Avec l'aide de ses amis, Spoon et Ema, il découvre un souterrain sombre qui pourrait contenir les réponses à des années de disparition.
cast: Jaden Michael, Constance Zimmer, Adrian Greensmith, Abby Corrigan, Sage Linder

name: FR - Blood Legacy
plot: After years of estrangement, Khanyi Adesina returns home to fight for her family's business empire as it threatens to collapse under corruption.
cast: Treasure Nkosi, Xolile Tshabalala, Buyile Mdladla, Mike Ndlangamandla, Connie Chiume

name: FR - Les patients du Docteur Garcia
plot: À Madrid en 1936, le destin d'un médecin idéaliste bascule à jamais lorsqu'il décide d'abriter un espion blessé et de participer à la longue lutte contre le fascisme.
cast: Javier Rey, Tamar Novas, Verónica Echegui, Eva Llorach, Raúl Jiménez

name: FR - Queenmaker
plot: After a tragic accident, a powerful fixer uses her skills to transform a civil rights lawyer into the next mayor — and take down her former employer.
cast: Kim Hee-ae, Moon So-ri, Ryu Soo-young, Seo Yi-sook, Ok Ja-yeon

name: FR - La Maison
plot: High fashion meets high drama in this behind-the-curtain look at an iconic French haute couture house. When the family dynasty behind the house falls into scandal, they must find a way to reinvent themselves—or be destroyed by their rivals.
cast: Lambert Wilson, Amira Casar, Carole Bouquet, Zita Hanrot, Pierre Deladonchamps

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: High fashion meets high drama in this behind-the-curtain look at an iconic French haute couture house. When the family dynasty behind the house falls into scandal, they must find a way to reinvent themselves—or be destroyed by their rivals.

name: FR - Pas de profit, pas d'amour
plot: Une romance zéro perte entre une femme qui déteste perdre et un homme qui se marie pour éviter de déranger.
cast: Shin Min-a, 김영대, 이상이, 한지현, 전혜원

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When it comes to family, love, or work, Son Hae-yeong has encountered loss after loss. In order to change her luck, Hae-yeong ends up seeking a fake wedding with her neighborhood convenience store employee, Kim Ji-uk, to avoid missing out on a promotion. Kim Ji-uk is known for being a model neighborhood citizen and works night shifts at a convenience store. A local hero who cannot ignore others in need, he agreed to Hae-yeong’s ridiculous proposal to be her fake groom for her fake wedding.

name: FR - LEGO Star Wars : Reconstruire la Galaxie
plot: La galaxie entière est bouleversée lorsqu'un berger ordinaire du nom de Sig Greebling déterre un artefact puissant provenant d'un temple Jedi caché. Il se retrouve plongé au cœur de l'aventure dans une nouvelle version de la galaxie où les personnages incontournables de l'univers ne sont plus ceux qu'il connaît. Le sort de la galaxie dépend de Sig et de sa capacité à devenir le héros qui remettra les pièces en ordre.
cast: Gaten Matarazzo, Tony Revolori, Marsai Martin, Bobby Moynihan

name: FR - Influence mortelle : réseaux assassins
plot: Les influenceurs renvoient une image de succès, de marques florissantes et de bénéfices records. Mais dans leur vie, la réalité est bien plus sombre.

name: FR - Du talent à revendre
plot: Un concours de talents hebdomadaire où un éventail d'artistes - des chanteurs et danseurs, aux comédiens et aux numéros de nouveauté - se disputent un prix en espèces d'un million de dollars.
cast: Simon Cowell, Howie Mandel, Sofía Vergara, Terry Crews, Heidi Klum

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: In season 8, Sharon Osbourne leaves the show with Melanie Brown replacing her, and Heidi Klum becomes the new fourth judge.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: In season 10. Howard Stern, Heidi Klum, Mel B and Howie Mandel return as judges, and Nick Cannon returns as host.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: In season 11, Simon Cowell joins the judges panel alongside Heidi Klum, Mel B and Howie Mandel. Nick Cannon is back as host, and the series returns to Los Angeles this summer, with live shows broadcast from the famed Dolby Theatre.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: On the heels of the most viewed season in five years, the 12th is back with creator and judge Simon Cowell, Mel B, Heidi Klum and Howie Mandel. Supermodel, entrepreneur and CEO Tyra Banks joins the team as host, and the series returns to Los Angeles with live shows from the famed Dolby Theatre.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: After a record-breaking Season 12, Creator and Judge Simon Cowell returns alongside Mel B, Heidi Klum and Howie Mandel. Supermodel, entrepreneur and business CEO Tyra Banks joined the team last summer as host and melded effortlessly with the judges, bringing her unmistakable personal flair and verve to the show.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: Creator and Executive Producer Simon Cowell returns to the judges' panel along with Howie Mandel. Also joining the panel this year are two fresh faces - award-winning actress, author and producer Gabrielle Union and Emmy Award-winning choreographer, actress, singer and dancer Julianne Hough. Terry Crews joins as host.

seasons.name: Season 15
seasons.overview: Creator and Executive Producer Simon Cowell is back at the star-studded judges' table with fan-favorite comedian Howie Mandel. Acclaimed actress and international superstar Sofia Vergara joins as a new judge this season alongside returning judge and global fashion icon Heidi Klum.  The dynamic Terry Crews returns as host.

name: FR - Agatha All Along
plot: Agatha Harkness gathers a coven of witches and sets off down, down, down The Witches' Road.
cast: Kathryn Hahn, Joe Locke, Sasheer Zamata, Ali Ahn, Okwui Okpokwasili

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The infamous Agatha Harkness finds herself down and out of power after a suspicious goth Teen helps break her free from a distorted spell. Her interest is piqued when he begs her to take him on the legendary Witches' Road, a magical gauntlet of trials that, if survived, rewards a witch with what they're missing. Together, Agatha and this mysterious Teen pull together a desperate coven, and set off down, down, down the Road...

name: FR - Expedition from Hell: The Lost Tapes
plot: Mickey Grosman, a former special forces demolitions expert took a group of amateur adventurers on a nearly impossible journey across South America. Positioned as a charity trek for cancer awareness, participants were to be part of a 5,000-mile expedition across the continent through the deepest parts of the Amazon jungle. Only one claims to have made it to the end… Mickey Grosman.
cast: Mickey Grosman

name: TAR - [مدبلج] منزلي
cast: Demet Özdemir, İbrahim Çelikkol, Zuhal Gencer, Senan Kara, Hülya Duyar

name: FR - Carpe Diem
cast: Samuel Le Bihan, Barbara Schulz, Jisca Kalvanda, Féodor Atkine, Timothée Vaganay

name: FR - Crevée
cast: Bianca Gervais, Sébastien Diaz, Marie-Pierre Duval, Valérie Landry, Geneviève Morand

name: FR - Les Stagiaires
plot: Six apprentis journalistes sont parachutés dans la salle des nouvelles de Radio-Canada le temps d’un stage aussi exigeant qu’exaltant. Formés par des professionnels de l’info et accompagnés tout au long de leur parcours par Marie-Maude Denis, les stagiaires sont confrontés chaque semaine à la réalité terrain du journalisme et doivent démontrer qu’ils ont leur place dans le monde de l’information .
cast: Isabelle Richer, Patrice Roy, Marie-Maude Denis

name: FR - Rising Impact
plot: Lorsque le don naturel d'un écolier pour le golf est découvert accidentellement par une joueuse professionnelle, le garçon se met en tête de devenir le meilleur golfeur du monde.
cast: 久野美咲, 花守ゆみり, 大地葉, 種﨑敦美, Katsuyuki Konishi

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Golf prodigy Gawain and Camelot Academy's Japan team take on gifted young golfers from the U.K. and U.S. schools in the coveted Camelot Cup.

name: FR - Pourquoi pas Evans ?
plot: Les derniers mots énigmatiques d'un mourant envoient le fils du vicaire, Bobby Jones, et son amie mondaine, Lady Frankie Derwent, dans une aventure de résolution de crime.
cast: Will Poulter, Lucy Boynton, Maeve Dermody, Conleth Hill, Daniel Ings

name: FR - Rematch
cast: Christian Cooke, Orion Lee, Sarah Bolger, Trine Dyrholm, Aidan Quinn

seasons.name: Miniseries
seasons.overview: 1997. Garry Kasparov, the greatest chess player of all time, faces Deep Blue, IBM's supercomputer. Two brains, face to face; one man against an empire; a battle of humans against machines that forever changed the perception of artificial intelligence.

name: FR - Playgame
cast: Moulaye Sall, Roselyne Marie Sylla, Naëtt Mbaye, Roch Peton, Arame Fall Faye

name: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace
plot: En visitant un hôtel historique d'Istanbul, une journaliste est renvoyée dans le passé et doit empêcher un complot qui pourrait changer le destin de la Turquie moderne.
cast: Yasemin Szawlowski, Tansu Biçer, Engin Hepileri

name: FR - Marco Lachance
plot: Marco Lachance was destined to become a music star, but instead his life turned monotonous. His positive nature demands that he take control of his destiny. As he reconnects with his passion, will he be able to overcome the obstacles life throws in his path?
cast: Michel Charette, Micheline Bernard, Cédric Thiffault, Cassandra Latreille, Hubert Proulx

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Marco Lachance was destined to become a music star, but instead his life turned monotonous. His positive nature demands that he take control of his destiny. As he reconnects with his passion, will he be able to overcome the obstacles life throws in his path?

name: FR - How to Die Alone
plot: Mel is a broke, fat, Black JFK airport employee who's never been in love and forgotten how to dream, until an accidental brush with death catapults her on a journey to finally take flight and start living by any means necessary.
cast: Natasha Rothwell, Conrad Ricamora, Jocko Sims, KeiLyn Durrel Jones

name: AR - اتجه شرقا
plot: During the peaceful Daming Dynasty, Yuan Mo, a commoner from Changle City, encounters A Shu, a refugee from Yanle Kingdom attempting to sneak in at the city gates. This conflict leads to Wang Kunwu being punished for failing to oversee his duties as a border general. As a consequence, Yuan Mo is inadvertently pulled into the Four Square Pavilion, where he forms a team with A Shu, Wang Kunwu, and Yuchi Hua. Together, they confront complex diplomatic challenges in their quest for justice and patriotism.
cast: Tan Jianci, Zhou Yiran, Du Chun, Kan Qingzi, Wei Zixin

name: AR - صديقها الرومانسي
plot: As the Lunar New Year nears, Qiu Feifei, fed up with marriage pressure, hires Ji Xuan, a drama student, to pose as her boyfriend. Her mother grows fond of him, but an unexpected event forces him to stay longer. With a new agreement in place, their charade continues, joined by friends Jin Mingming and her boyfriend, leading to a series of comical mishaps.
cast: Duan Xiaowei, Cai Zhengjie, Zhou Ziqian, Wanting Liu, Chen Mu

name: AR - كانتاي كانتاي
plot: Set against the misty, storm-lashed backdrop of Darjeeling, ‘Kaantaye Kaantaye’ plunges viewers into a world where nothing is as it seems. P.K. Basu [Saswata Chatterjee], haunted by the tragic loss of his daughter, finds himself in a race against time at the ominous Hotel Repose.

name: FR - The Winchesters
plot: Before Sam and Dean, there was John and Mary. Told from the perspective of narrator Dean Winchester, this is the epic, untold love story of how John met Mary, and how they put it all on the line to not only save their love, but the entire world.
cast: Meg Donnelly, Drake Rodger, Nida Khurshid, Jojo Fleites, Demetria McKinney

name: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict
plot: Un groupe d’orphelins infiltré dans un internat s’efforce de contrecarrer un projet machiavélique d’ampleur planétaire et se découvre par la même occasion une nouvelle famille...
cast: Tony Hale, Kristen Schaal, Mystic Inscho, Seth Carr, Марта Кесслер

name: FR - Misfits
plot: When five young outsiders on Community Service get caught in a strange storm, they discover that they have developed superpowers.
cast: Joseph Gilgun, Karla Crome, Nathan McMullen, Matt Stokoe, Shaun Dooley

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: Five unruly teenagers forced into community service to atone for their crimes develop superhero powers when a freak electrical storm hits them.

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: Nathan, Kelly and the gang discover that they're not the only ones affected by the storm as they now face a whole new world of weird characters.

seasons.name: Series 3
seasons.overview: New kid Rudy joins the gang of superpower-wielding kids this season. Meanwhile, the original misfits deal with some brand-new powers.

seasons.name: Series 4
seasons.overview: While new member Finn searches for his father, fellow newcomer Jess starts dating a guy who is searching for a missing piece of his anatomy.

seasons.name: Series 5
seasons.overview: As the first anniversary of the storm approaches, the Misfits fulfill their community service, ultimately pitting them against someone among them.

name: TAR - لا أحد يعلم
plot: تدور احداث المسلسل حول علي ( كرم جيم ) الشاب الذي فقد عائلته كلها، لكنه يعرف أن لديه أخ واحد يحاول البحث عنه في كل مكان، ( علي ) ليس فقط شاب وحيد بل لديه قدرات خارقة، وقوة ليست عن أحد ، عرفه جيرانه بتلك القوة، ولقبوه بالمعلم، لكن يشاء القدر أن تطارد الشرطة سيفدا وتحاول الهروب منها حتى استطاعة أن تلتجئ بمكان، هذا المكان ملك لعلي ، يوجد الكثير من القصص والحكايات بداخل المسلسل سنتعرف عليها
cast: Keremcem, Özgü Kaya, Engin Hepileri, Burak Serdar Şanal, Zeynep Elçin

name: AR - بيت العنكبوت
plot: يعمل الشقيقان راشد وفيصل مع والدهما في تجارة الذهب، لكن طمعهما في المال والسلطة يزرع بذور عداوة بينهما، ستحرص زوجة أبيهما نورا على تغذية نارها بمهارة...

name: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist
plot: Zoey, dont le père Mitch est atteint d'une maladie neurologique, passe un IRM, craignant de développer elle-même des symptômes. Un tremblement de terre survient pendant l'examen. Zoey se met alors à "entendre" les pensées des gens sous forme de chansons. Cette nouvelle aptitude lui permet d'approcher Simon, un collègue de travail dont elle est amoureuse et de communiquer avec son père. Mais elle découvre également que Max, son meilleur ami, est secrètement amoureux d'elle. Elle gagne la course à la promotion organisée par sa patronne, Joan, en trouvant l'origine du bug qui empêchait la sortie de la nouvelle appli de son entreprise.
cast: Jane Levy, Skylar Astin, Alex Newell, John Clarence Stewart, Andrew Leeds

name: FR - Motherland: Fort Salem
plot: Set in an alternate America where witches ended their persecution over 300 years ago by cutting a deal with the government to fight for their country, the series follows three young women from basic training in combat magic into early deployment.
cast: Taylor Hickson, Amalia Holm Bjelke, Ashley Nicole Williams, Lyne Renee, Jessica Sutton

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Set in an alternate America where witches ended their persecution nearly 300 years ago by cutting a deal with the U.S. government to fight for their country, “Motherland: Fort Salem” follows three young women from basic training in combat magic into early deployment.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Raelle, Tally and Abigail confront higher stakes, dangerous magic and a new threat from an ancient group of witch hunters, The Camarilla. Their training is intensified when they are promoted to attend War College, where their magic, relationships and beliefs will be pushed to the limits. While General Alder seeks out new witches to join the wars to come, The Spree and the Army learn their fight may no longer be with one another.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Without a military nor a home, Abigail, Tally, Raelle and Scylla seek protection alongside the Dodger community in the Cession — but laying low and staying out of trouble has never been their strong suit. With witch hunters working against them from inside the White House, our heroes must call upon ancient forces in the final battle for their right to exist.

name: FR - Baraki
plot: The entire region knows the Berthet family. When people talk about them, they call them ‘gypsies’. Larissa Berthet houses her entire tribe in her home, including Yvan, a local orphan whom she took in and raised as her son. When Yvan finds out that he is to become a father, he decides to become a ‘normal’ man. However, a local bipolar dealer, a jealous cop, an unstable ex and a Machiavellian stepmother have other plans. Luckily, his family is there to support him. But when you’re a Berthet some things just aren’t as simple as they seem.
cast: Pierre Nisse, Sophia Leboutte, Laura Sépul

name: FR - B Positive
plot: Faced with finding a kidney donor, newly divorced dad Drew is at the end of his rope when he runs into Gina, a rough-around-the edges woman from his past who volunteers her own. Together they form an unlikely bond and begin a journey that will change both of their lives.
cast: Annaleigh Ashford, Thomas Middleditch, Kether Donohue, Darryl Stephens, Linda Lavin

name: FR - Arrête Papa, tu me fais honte !
plot: Un père célibataire, propriétaire d'une marque de cosmétiques, découvre la paternité sur le tas lorsque sa fille adolescente au caractère bien trempé emménage avec lui.
cast: Jamie Foxx, Kyla-Drew, David Alan Grier, Porscha Coleman, Heather Hemmens

name: FR - L'Écuyer du Roi
plot: Entre anciennes prophéties, pouvoirs magiques et compagnons capricieux, un jeune apprenti chevalier se lance dans une aventure épique pour sauver son royaume.
cast: Amir Wilson, Ruby Ashbourne Serkis, Thaddea Graham, Islam Bouakkaz, Jonah Lees

name: FR - SKY Castle
plot: For the families living at Sky Castle, an exclusive residential community that's home to Korea's elite, their children’s success means everything.
cast: Yum Jung-ah, Yoon Se-a, Lee Tae-ran, Kim Seo-hyung, Oh Na-ra

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: For the families living at Sky Castle, an exclusive residential community that's home to Korea's elite, their children’s success means everything.

name: FR - MR.BRAIN
plot: Ryusuke Tsukumo is a quirky, yet brilliant neuroscientist working for the National Research Institute of Police Science. Wielding a unique perspective and psychology, Tsukumo tackles the nation's most baffling crimes and scandals, going head-to-head with the most brilliant and twisted criminal minds. But his eccentricities and poor social timing can also aggravate people and circumstances, further complicating matters.
cast: Takuya Kimura, Teruyuki Kagawa, Haruka Ayase, Hiro Mizushima, Ichikawa Ebizo XI

name: FR - Rooftop Prince
plot: Crown Prince Yi Gak finds that he has been transported from the Chosun Dynasty to modern-day Seoul. He meets Hong Se Na, who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife, and is determined to solve the 300-year-old mystery of her death. With his own resemblance to the CEO’s grandson at the company where Se Na works, Gak assumes the identity of the young man to stay close to her. Can the Crown Prince navigate a modern corporation to find clues to his own time period?
cast: Park Yoo-chun, Han Ji-min, Jeong Yu-mi, Kim So-hyun, Lee Tae-sung

name: FR - Les sirènes de Mako
plot: Zac, 16 ans, décide de camper avec son ami, Cam, sur la mystérieuse île de Mako. Il trouve une ouverture dans la roche et tombe. Chargées de défendre cette roche volcanique, trois sirènes le sauvent. Le lendemain, Zac découvre qu'il est devenu triton doté de pouvoir surnaturels. Bannies par les leurs, les trois jeunes femmes doivent tout faire pour récupérer les nouveaux pouvoirs de Zac et décident de vivre sur Terre afin d'accomplir leur mission.
cast: Allie Bertram, Isabel Durant, Linda Ngo, Chai Hansen, Gemma Forsyth

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Sirena, Nixie and Lyla are part of a mermaid pod, which lives in the waters of Mako Island. As young members of the pod, it is their job to protect the Moon Pool and guard it from trespassers. But on the night of a full moon, the mischievous mermaid girls neglect their duties. Sixteen-year-old land-dweller Zac enters the Moon Pool and forms a special connection with Mako. Zac is given a fish-like tail and amazing powers. The mermaid pod is forced to leave Mako, leaving behind the three mermaid girls, cast out of the pod. They know there's only one way they will be allowed to rejoin the pod: They must get legs, venture onto land and take back Zac's powers – or risk being outcasts forever.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Mako is a magical Island that a pod of mermaids call home. Their peaceful lives are turned upside down when Zac, a merman develops a connection with the island that poses a threat to their existence. Ondina and Mimmi, two young mermaids from the Mako pod, are determined to break Zac's connection to Mako Island and reclaim Mako for the pod. As the mermaids struggle to take back his powers, they discover that his connection with Mako isn't quite an accident. New mermaids and mermen are met along the way, and some are even created!

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Life is trouble-free on Mako Island – until Ondina meets Weilan, a mermaid from the Eastern pod. They immediately clash and Mimmi must act as peacemaker. But a greater threat to their peace has arrived, in the form of a fearsome Chinese water dragon that once destroyed the Eastern pod. But the dragon is not all it appears to be. On their perilous quest to defeat the dragon, Zac and the mermaids discover shocking secrets until a final confrontation reveals all.

name: FR - Pushing Daisies
plot: A pie-maker, with the power to bring dead people back to life, solves murder mysteries with his alive-again childhood sweetheart, a cynical private investigator, and a lovesick waitress.
cast: Lee Pace, Anna Friel, Chi McBride, Kristin Chenoweth, Swoosie Kurtz

name: FR - Niko et L'épee de Lumière
plot: Une vague d'ombres a deferlé sur la Terre, transformant d'innocentes créatures en de terribles monstres. Seul un champion se dresse, prêt à combattre les ténèbres et à renvoyer le monde à la lumière : Niko. Armé de son épée magique et guidé par une princesse déterminée, Niko se rend au Volcan de la Malédiction pour faire face au maléfique Nar Est et libérer son peuple de sa prison magique.
cast: Andre Robinson, Kari Wahlgren, Jim Cummings, Dee Bradley Baker, Steve Blum

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A plague of shadows has swept across the land, turning innocent creatures into terrible monsters.  One champion remains to battle the darkness and return the world to the light: Niko.  Armed with his magic sword, and guided by a determined Princess, young Niko journeys to the Curse-ed Volcano to face the evil sorcerer Nar Est and free his people from their magic prison.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Chapter Two: The Amulet of Power. Niko's world has been restored, but a new dark power looms in the shadows, waiting for a chance to strike. Only the fabled Amulet of Power can restore the balance between Light and Dark. Niko and his friends must race against the forces of darkness to protect this mysterious relic, an artifact that may hold clues to Niko’s very existence.

name: FR - PicPic et André
plot: Pic Pic porte une chemise bleue, il n'est pas très intelligent mais a bon cœur. Afin de devenir magique, Pic Pic doit effectuer une danse qui consiste à faire des tours puis de se secouer les épaules. Il peut ensuite s'envoler accompagné de son trident magique. Pour redevenir "normal" Pic pic doit taper avec son poing dans la paume de son autre main.  André est le cheval de Coboy le cow-boy. Son passe temps favori est de jouer des mauvais tours et boire de la bière. Par colère, Coboy tue toujours André, puis pris de remords il va pleurer sur sa tombe. André finit toujours par ressusciter et l'histoire se répète

name: FR - Backstrom
plot: Detective Lieutenant Everett Backstrom is a man with no filter. After a five-year exile to the traffic division for offensive behavior, he has returned from disgrace to lead Portland's newly minted S.C.U. Tasked with navigating the city's most sensitive and serious cases, he must solve each crime as he tries, and fails, to change his own self-destructive behavior. Based on renowned Swedish criminologist and novelist Leif G.W. Persson’s hit series of books of the same name.
cast: Rainn Wilson, Beatrice Rosen, Dennis Haysbert, Genevieve Angelson, Kristoffer Polaha

name: FR - Fearless
plot: Emma Banville, a human rights lawyer known for defending lost causes, sets out to prove the innocence of Kevin Russell, who was convicted for the murder of a school girl 14 years earlier.
cast: Helen McCrory, Jonathan Forbes, Sam Swainsbury, Wunmi Mosaku, Rebecca Callard

name: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération
plot: Quatre petites tortues exposées à des produits radioactifs dans les égoûts de New York ont muté et deviennent des créatures intelligentes. Entraînées aux art-martiaux par leur maître Splinter, les Tortues Ninjas sortent la nuit, pour faire regner la justice. Une nouvelle menace nommée Dragon Lord arrive et les oblige à intervenir.
cast: Kirby Morrow, Matt Hill, Jason Gray-Stanford, Michael Dobson, Lalainia Lindbjerg

name: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
plot: Peter Quill is Star-Lord, the brash adventurer who, to save the universe from its greatest threats, joins forces with a quartet of disparate misfits — fan-favorite Rocket Raccoon, a tree-like humanoid named Groot, the enigmatic, expert fighter Gamora and the rough edged warrior Drax the Destroyer.
cast: Will Friedle, Trevor Devall, Vanessa Marshall, David Sobolov, Jeff Bennett

name: FR - LEGO: Jurassic World - Legend of Isla Nublar
plot: Set in 2012, three years before the Jurassic World movie, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing team up on Isla Nublar to deal with everything the Jurassic World park throws their way, including a mysterious saboteur who wants to destroy the park forever!
cast: Britt McKillip, Ian Hanlin, Nicholas Holmes

name: FR - LEGO Marvel Super Heroes - Black Panther: Trouble in Wakanda
FR - Les Bébés Looney Tunes
plot: Les Baby Looney Tunes sont adorables et vivent tous ensemble dans une grande maison victorienne sous l'oeil bienveillant de Mémé. Baby Bugs prend son rôle de chef de bande très à coeur. Il veille sur ses amis Baby Titi et Baby Grosminet, dont la tendresse laisse cependant présager d'un avenir des plus agités.
cast: Sam Vincent, Terry Klassen, Britt McKillip, Ian James Corlett, June Foray

name: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or
plot: Le XVIe siècle. Des quatre coins de l'Europe, de gigantesques voiliers partent à la conquête du Nouveau Monde. À bord de ces navires, des hommes avides de rêves, d'aventure et d'espace, à la recherche de fortune. Qui n'a jamais rêvé de ces mondes souterrains, de ces mers lointaines peuplées de légendes ou d'une richesse soudaine qui se conquérait au détour d'un chemin de la Cordillère des Andes ? Qui n'a jamais souhaité voir le soleil souverain guider ses pas, au cœur du pays Inca, vers la richesse et l'histoire des mystérieuses cités d'or ?
cast: 佐久間レイ, 野沢雅子, ささきいさお, Junko Hori

name: FR - La Garde du Roi Lion : Un Nouveau Cri
plot: Le fils de Simba, Kion, crée un groupe d'animal pour protéger la Terre des Lions connu sous le nom de "La Garde du Roi Lion"
cast: Dusan Brown, Joshua Rush, Max Charles, Atticus Shaffer, Diamond White

name: FR - La Ligue des justiciers : Action
plot: Batman, Superman et Wonder Woman mènent les super-héros de la Terre dans leur lutte contre les ennemis de l'univers...

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: Specials include Shazam Slam! and the Justice League Action Shorts.

name: FR - Grizzy & the Lemmings
plot: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.
cast: Pierre-Alain de Garrigues, Josselin Charier

name: FR - Hotel Transylvania: The Series
plot: Mavis navigates life without her dad, Dracula, around and discovers one of the few common human and monster truths: being a teenager bites.
cast: Bryn McAuley, Evany Rosen

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: With her dad away, Mavis is so ready for adventure -- if strict Aunt Lydia doesn't stop her first. Set four years before the "Hotel Transylvania" film.

name: FR - Once Upon a Time... Life
plot: Attention please! Are you ready for an adventurous tour through the human body? With a lot of humour, our physical appearance is being introduced from head to toe along cells and organs in an educational way. The heart, blood, nerves and kidneys, each single one is a miracle which renders life possible.
cast: Roger Carel, Gilles Laurent, Marie-Laure Beneston, Alain Dorval, Henry Djanik

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Buckle up for a head-to-toe adventure through the human body as this animated series explores the workings of our cells, hearts, brains and more.

name: FR - Once Upon a Time... Planet Earth
plot: Teenagers, the internationally-recognized characters of the series, will be the heroes of adventures in which they will play an active role. They will be a force for change, faced with situations and problems they need to resolve. The series will be based on facts, yet still primarily entertainment. Through their actions, they directly affect their planet and the resources that must be used responsibly and are not inexhaustible. The series will also help younger audiences to understand that pollution, hunger and water shortages are realities with specific causes – rather than inevitable evils to be dreaded, they are battles to be won with solutions to be found.
cast: Roger Carel, Annie Balestra, Alain Dorval

name: FR - Gangland Undercover
plot: This drama series is a fictionalized retelling of the story of meth dealer-turned-ATF informant Charles Falco, who spent three years inside one of America's most dangerous motorcycle gangs, the Vagos. Although Falco originally took on the assignment to avoid spending 20 years in prison on drug charges, it eventually evolved into a quest for justice for him. “Gangland Undercover” documents the lives of outlaw bikers, who live in a world in which respect is earned through fear. The series is based on Falco's memoir, “Vagos, Mongols, and Outlaws,” and documented historical research of gang rivalries.
cast: Damon Runyan, Ari Cohen, James Cade, Ian Matthews, Don Francks

name: FR - Lie to Me
plot: The world's leading deception researcher, Dr. Cal Lightman, studies facial expression, body language and tone of voice to determine when a person is lying and why, which helps law enforcement and government agencies uncover the truth. But his skills also make it easier for him to deceive others.
cast: Tim Roth, Kelli Williams, Monica Raymund, Brendan Hines, Hayley McFarland

name: FR - For The People
plot: Brand new lawyers work for both the defense and the prosecution as they handle the most high profile and high stakes cases in the country – all as their personal lives intersect.
cast: Hope Davis, Ben Shenkman, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Susannah Flood, Wesam Keesh

name: FR - Mary Kills People
plot: Dr. Mary Harris, a single mother and emergency doctor by day, also moonlights as an underground angel of death - helping terminally ill patients who want to die and slip away on their own terms. So far Mary has managed to stay under the radar; but business is booming, and her double life is getting complicated. When her world starts to unravel, Mary realizes she's going to have to fight dirty if she's going to stay in the killing game.
cast: Caroline Dhavernas, Richard Short, Katie Douglas

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Season 1 follows Dr. Mary Harris, an overworked single mother and ER doctor who also moonlights as an underground angel of death, working outside the law assisting patients who want to die on their own terms. So far Mary has managed to stay under the radar but business is booming, and her double life is getting complicated.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season 2, Mary plummets deeper into the criminal world as she searches for a steady supply of pentobarbital, the highly regulated and highly lethal "death drug." As she becomes more entangled in her illegal work, Mary continues to risk her family and career as she tries to keep her worlds separate. But when the mysterious Olivia Bloom approaches Mary and her partner Des with a lethal request, and when Mary crosses unexpectedly with Detective Ben Wesley, she realizes her secrets can only be hidden for so long.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In the third and final chapter, Dr. Mary Harris must come face-to-face with her own personal choices, ethics, and demons in a way she never has before. The death retreat is up and running, but its cover as a legitimate hospice is crumbling away and with it the idyllic vision Mary and Des had for continuing their work in quiet secrecy. With Mary’s family and the work she loves in jeopardy once more, she realizes she is finally going to have to put life, with all of its complexities and imperfections, first.

name: FR - McMafia
plot: Alex Godman, the English-raised son of Russian mafia exiles, has spent his life trying to escape the shadow of their past, building his own legitimate business and forging a life with his girlfriend Rebecca. But when a murder forces his family's past to return to threaten them, Alex is drawn into the criminal underworld and must confront his values to protect those he loves.
cast: James Norton, Juliet Rylance, Faye Marsay, Kirill Pirogov

name: FR - Esprits Criminels : Unité Sans Frontières
plot: La division internationale du FBI, menée par Jack Garrett et constituée de profilers, parcourt le monde avec pour mission de sauver des citoyens américains portés disparus à l'étranger. Jack Garrett et ses agents, Jarvis, Simmons, Seger et Montgomery allient des compétences en informatique, médecine, sociologie et intervention sur le terrain. Leur qualité d’analyse des situations et leur rapidité d'exécution sont primordiales pour mener à bien leurs actions et chaque enquête devient vite une course contre la montre pour éviter le pire…
cast: Gary Sinise, Daniel Henney, Tyler James Williams, Annie Funke, Alana de la Garza

name: FR - Doctor Foster
plot: A woman suspects her husband of having an affair. After following several lines of enquiries far more unravels including a streak of violence below the surface.
cast: Suranne Jones, Bertie Carvel, Clare-Hope Ashitey, Isabelle Estelle Corbusier, Thusitha Jayasundera

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: Dr Foster's world fractures in unpredictable ways when her adulterous husband reappears.

name: FR - Private Eyes
plot: Ex-pro hockey player Matt Shade irrevocably changes his life when he teams up with fierce P.I. Angie Everett to form an unlikely investigative powerhouse.
cast: Jason Priestley, Cindy Sampson, Barry Flatman, Jordyn Negri

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The original crime-solving series Private Eyes is a 10-episode procedural drama that follows ex-pro hockey player Matt Shade who irrevocably changes his life when he decides to team up with fierce P.I. Angie Everett to form an unlikely investigative powerhouse. Through their new partnership, Shade is forced to examine who he has become and who he wants to be. Ongoing episodes find Shade and Angie investigating high-stakes crimes in the worlds of horse racing, fine dining, Toronto's vibrant hip-hop scene, scandalous literature, magic clubs, and more.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Matt Shade irrevocably changed his life when he decided to team up with fierce PI Angie Everett. Now, this dynamic duo has found their rhythm both on and off the case. They still view the world through different lenses, but have learned to use each other’s strengths to their mutual advantage…mostly. With their new equal partnership comes a booming business, and they opt to hire an assistant in the form of quirky Zoe Chow.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Angie finds herself behind bars and it is up to her trusted partner to bail Angie out so they can work together to recover the sensitive government intel and prove her innocence. Leveraging each other’s strengths, and the quirky skillset of their assistant Zoe Chow, Shade and Angie strive to get their reputation back on track. Along the way, the detective duo discover that their partnership may go beyond the agency’s confines…

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Season 4 picks up following a paternity bombshell dropped in Matt Shade’s lap, presenting a sudden realization that family is far more complicated than he ever anticipated. Helping to keep him grounded is his partner, whip-smart PI Angie Everett, whose concern for Shade’s well-being involves a secret DNA test and more than a few white lies. Luckily, a pressing case becomes a welcome distraction from personal conflicts as Shade and Angie delve into the mystery of a wealthy family whose Gatsby-themed party becomes a setting for battles over inheritance…and murder.

name: FR - Cardinal
plot: Detective John Cardinal attempts to uncover the mystery of what happened to the missing 13-year-old girl whose body is discovered in the shaft-head of an abandoned mine. At the same time, he comes under investigation by his new partner, Lise Delorme, a tough investigator in her own right.
cast: Billy Campbell, Karine Vanasse

seasons.name: Blackfly Season
seasons.overview: It’s early summer in Algonquin Bay and the blackflies aren’t the only ones out for blood. Detectives John Cardinal and Lise Delorme find themselves with a strange case on their hands involving a young woman with a gunshot wound to the head. The investigation quickly takes a turn as Cardinal and Delorme uncover a series of disturbing, ritualistic killings that may be connected to their young victim.

seasons.name: By the Time You Read This
seasons.overview: As Detective John Cardinal and Lise Delorme’s investigation into Algonquin Bay’s most gruesome double murder brings them precariously close to a doomsday cult with nothing to lose, Cardinal launches his own investigation into a case far more personal and dangerous. With doubts about Catherine’s suicide swirling beneath Cardinal’s placid exterior, Delorme stretched thin in her role as lead investigator on an increasingly complex, and far-reaching case, the pursuit of the killers will push them both to the breaking point. Delorme must decide whether she can trust Cardinal, or whether the death of his wife has sent him into a delusional state that puts the entire case at risk.

seasons.name: Until the Night
seasons.overview: Detectives John Cardinal and Lise Delorme have grown closer as friends and partners. There’s a strong bond between them that transcends the job, a bond that deepens all the time and yet remains largely unspoken. But when a seemingly mundane missing persons case turns into a spree of nightmarish murders, the ensuing investigation pushes them to their limits as detectives and partners, forcing them each to face what their future holds.

name: AR - ملكة الخصم
cast: 趙弈欽, Li Jiaqi, Jiang Junhan, 潘悦

name: AR - الخطيئة الأصلية
cast: 翟天臨, 白冰, Cherry Ngan, Li Ruoning, 尹正

name: FR - Reginald the Vampire
plot: Imagine a world populated by beautiful, fit and vain vampires. Reginald Andres tumbles headlong into it as an unlikely hero who will have to navigate every kind of obstacle – the girl he loves but can’t be with, a bully manager at work and the vampire chieftain who wants him dead. Fortunately, Reginald discovers he has a few unrecognized powers of his own.
cast: Jacob Batalon, Mandela Van Peebles, Em Haine, Aren Buchholz, Savannah Basley

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Reginald Andres finally got his life together – when he was turned into a vampire. While he doesn’t fit into the stereotypical expectations of what a vampire looks like – he’s not chiseled or classically handsome – Reginald has found his place amongst an unlikely cohort that includes the cool vampire who sired him, the former vampire chieftain turned unexpected ally (or is she?), and his co-worker/former girlfriend. A show with a lot of heart and just enough blood, "Reginald the Vampire" proves the undead life is just as complicated as life itself.

name: FR - L'Île prisonnière
plot: Une île sans histoire jusqu’au jour où une vingtaine d’activistes armés débarquent et confinent tous les habitants dans l’école du village. Alpha, leur chef, a tout prévu, excepté que la navette qui relie Penhic au continent leur échappe et permette à cinq de ses passagers de se cacher sur l’île. Qui sont ces activistes ? Pourquoi retiennent-ils prisonniers les habitants de Penhic ? Qui parmi eux deviendra héros, lâche ou traître ? Qui est l’inconnu de la navette qui revient après dix ans d’absence ?
cast: Déborah François, Margot Bancilhon, Pierre Perrier, Kévin Azaïs, Anouk Grinberg

name: FR - The Fabulous
plot: Four best friends chase their dreams in the competitive world of fashion while juggling demanding jobs, romantic dilemmas and wild nights on the town.
cast: Chae Soo-bin, Minho, Lee Sang-un, Park Hee-jeong, Kim Min-kyu

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Four best friends chase their dreams in the competitive world of fashion while juggling demanding jobs, romantic dilemmas and wild nights on the town.

name: FR - Three Pines
plot: Chief Inspector Armand Gamache and his team investigate a series of perplexing murders, in the seemingly idyllic village of Three Pines and uncover the buried secrets of its eccentric residents. In the process, Gamache is forced to confront buried secrets of his own. Based on the novels by Louise Penny.
cast: Alfred Molina, Rossif Sutherland, Elle-Máijá Tailfeathers, Sarah Booth, Anna Tierney

name: FR - SAS: Rogue Heroes
plot: The dramatised account of how the world’s greatest Special Forces unit, the SAS, was formed under extraordinary circumstances in the darkest days of World War Two.
cast: Alfie Allen, Connor Swindells, Jack O'Connell, Sofia Boutella, Dominic West

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: Spring, 1943. Paddy Mayne takes control of the SAS following David Stirling's capture, as attention turns from the conflict in North Africa to mainland Europe. But GHQ have cast doubt over the future of the regiment, while the creation of a second unit and an influx of new arrivals make things even more difficult for the men. Can they prove that the SAS remains essential to the war, wherever it may lead them?

name: FR - Champions à tout prix
plot: Après avoir dépensé jusqu'au dernier sou pour emmener son fils à la Coupe du Monde, Lucho est dévasté car son pays accro au football, l'Argentine, est disqualifié par punition. Pour permettre à son fils d'apprendre à rêver à nouveau et pour réintégrer l'Argentine au tournoi, Lucho monte le plan le plus fou de l'histoire du football : voler le trophée de la Coupe du Monde.
cast: Joaquín Furriel, Benjamín Amadeo, Carla Quevedo, Agustina Tremari, Matías Luque Benante

name: AR - فعل ماضي
plot: Hind lives peacefully with her renowned doctor husband and two daughters, but her past of private parties threatens to resurface when her former partner reappears in her life…
cast: Shejoun, Mahmoud Bushehry, Ali Kakule

name: AR - ثانوية بلا رومانسية
plot: When an ultra-elite high school enforces a strict "No Romance" rule that expels anyone caught dating, a student secretly helps her classmates for cash.
cast: Ai Mikami, Ryubi Miyase, Rintaro Mizusawa, Yudai Toyoda, Honda Kyoya

name: AR - اختطاف طائرة قندهار
plot: When IC 814 gets hijacked on its way to Delhi, hundreds of lives are at stake as the country faces its longest and most alarming aviation crisis.
cast: Vijay Varma, Naseeruddin Shah, Pankaj Kapur, Arvind Swamy, Dia Mirza

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Based on real events, this gripping series directed by Anubhav Sinha (“Article 15”) chronicles the longest hijack in the history of Indian aviation.

name: AR - مخفر جيا غون
plot: Facing a trail of murders staged as chilling word games, a rookie police captain and a goofy detective race to solve a serial killer's deadly puzzles.
cast: Greg Hsu, Gingle Wang, Ma Nien-Hsien, Ki-pin Ng, LULU Huang

name: FR - This England - Les années Boris Johnson
plot: Inside the halls of power, Boris Johnson  grapples with Covid-19, Brexit, and a controversial personal and political life during his tumultuous first months as Prime Minister.
cast: Kenneth Branagh, Ophelia Lovibond, Simon Paisley Day, Charles Dance, Andrew Buchan

name: FR - Meurtre au Polonium - L'affaire Litvinenko
plot: The story of the determined Scotland Yard Officers who worked to prove who was responsible for the death of Alexander Litvinenko, in one of the most complex and dangerous investigations in the history of the Metropolitan Police.
cast: David Tennant, Mark Bonnar, Barry Sloane, Daniel Ryan, Richard Pepper

name: FR - Lie with Me
plot: A British woman and her husband seek a fresh start in Australia after infidelity in their marriage. The couple hire a young nanny, but she isn't the innocent stranger she pretends to be.
cast: Charlie Brooks, Brett Tucker, Phoebe Roberts, Alba Nicholls, Nadine Garner

name: FR - KAOS
plot: As discord reigns on Mount Olympus and almighty Zeus spirals into paranoia, three mortals are destined to reshape the future of humankind.
cast: Jeff Goldblum

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As discord reigns on Mount Olympus and almighty Zeus spirals into paranoia, three mortals are destined to reshape the future of humankind.

name: FR - Terminator Zero
plot: A warrior from a post-apocalyptic future travels to 1997 to protect an AI scientist being hunted by an unfeeling — and indestructible — cyborg.
cast: Yuuya Uchida, Hiro Shimono, Saori Hayami, Toa Yukinari, Atsumi Tanezaki

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: 2022: A future war has raged for decades between the few human survivors and an endless army of machines. 1997: The AI known as Skynet gained self-awareness and began its war against humanity. Caught between the future and this past is a soldier sent back in time to change the fate of humanity. She arrives in 1997 to protect a scientist named Malcolm Lee who works to launch a new AI system designed to compete with Skynet's impending attack on humanity. As Malcolm navigates the moral complexities of his creation, he is hunted by an unrelenting assassin from the future which forever alters the fate of his three children.

name: FR - Chastity High
plot: When an ultra-elite high school enforces a strict "No Romance" rule that expels anyone caught dating, a student secretly helps her classmates for cash.
cast: Ai Mikami, Ryubi Miyase, Rintaro Mizusawa, Yudai Toyoda, Shiori Akita

name: FR - Un meurtre est-il facile ?
plot: England, 1954. On a train to London, Fitzwilliam meets Miss Pinkerton, who tells him that a killer is on the loose in the sleepy English village of Wychwood under Ashe. The villagers believe the deaths are accidents, but Miss Pinkerton knows otherwise — and when she’s later found dead on her way to Scotland Yard, Fitzwilliam feels he must find the killer before they can strike again.
cast: David Jonsson, Morfydd Clark, Penelope Wilton, Sinead Matthews, Tom Riley

name: AR - كصمت الغابة
plot: One tranquil summer, a mysterious woman checks into a vacation rental — triggering events that disrupt the lives of the owner and those around him.
cast: Kim Yun-seok, Yoon Kye-sang, Go Min-si, Lee Jung-eun, Ha Yoon-kyung

name: TAR - إخوتي [مدبلج]
plot: تدور أحداث هذا المسلسل حول النضال المؤلم والمستمر لهؤلاء الأشقاء الأربعة الذين لم يتبقى لهم إلا بعضهم البعض بعد فقدانهم لوالديهم في تسلسل أحداث مؤسف.
cast: Fadik Sevin Atasoy, Su Burcu Yazgı Coşkun, Bilal Yiğit Koçak, Cüneyt Mete, Celil Nalçakan

name: FR - Love Is Blind
plot: Nick and Vanessa Lachey host this social experiment where single men and women look for love and get engaged, all before meeting in person.

seasons.name: Season 2

After seeing how skilled the RedSuns are, the SpeedStars treat it as a race for pride, determined not to be humiliated on their home turf. However, the SpeedStars are left in a bind when their team leader and primary downhill driver Iketani has an accident during a practice run.

seasons.name: Second Stage
seasons.overview: A group of street racers called Team Emperor, all using Mitsubishi Lancer Evolutions, appear in the Gunma area, defeating anyone in their path, until their No. 2 racer, Seiji Iwaki, was defeated by Takumi, breaking their winning streak. Their leader, a professionally-trained driver named Kyoichi Sudo, challenged Takumi to a race at Akagi to “teach him some things” and as a sort of cover event for his race with Ryosuke, his primary target. Takumi declined his proposal at first but eventually accepted after being infuriated with seeing Natsuki with the Mercedes Driver which left him at a disadvantage from the get-go. This race saw Takumi's Eight-Six blow its engine. While it may have been a defeat for Takumi, Kyoichi did not consider it a race instead considering it more as a seminar to show Takumi how much he needs a better car as he believes the Eight-Six is far too old to match Takumi's skill level.

seasons.name: Fourth Stage
seasons.overview: This series focuses on the exploits of the new team founded by Ryosuke, Project.D, which is composed of Ryosuke (leader and strategist), downhill specialist Takumi, uphill specialist Keisuke, and a staff consisting primarily of members of the Akagi Red Suns. The team travels the region, challenging other teams and posting the results of the battles on their website. Each race is intended by Ryosuke to develop a specific area of his drivers' skills. By this time, Takumi matures slowly into a more confident and knowledgeable street racer, while Keisuke improves on his technical driving skills. Takumi instinctively develops many new techniques through his own ingenuity after some prompting by Ryosuke, such as "Blind Attack", a passing with his headlights off so that his opponent is unable to see him coming and block him, and using weight shifting to execute manoeuvres similar to the gutter-hook technique on Akina.

seasons.name: Fifth Stage
seasons.overview: Still working as part of the Project D driving team, Takumi Fujiwara and Keisuke Takahashi continue to challenge courses and teams in the Kanagawa Prefecture. Meanwhile, a young golf phenom catches Takumi's eye, and Ryosuke Takahashi settles a score from his past.

seasons.name: Final Stage
seasons.overview: After a long break, after every racing team in the prefecture is defeated, everything comes down to one last race.
