From a remote farm in Norway, to an enigmatic compound in New Mexico, to the serpentine tunnels of Jerusalem, he searches for the truth, the revelation of which will shake the world's beliefs to its very core.
cast: Jason Isaacs, Ori Pfeffer, Anne Heche, Angela Bettis, Omar Metwally

name: FR - Damnation
plot: Seth Davenport is masquerading as a small town Iowa preacher in the hopes of starting a full-blown insurrection against the status quo, unaware that an industrialist tycoon has hired a professional strikebreaker to stop the uprising by any means necessary. An epic saga of the secret history of the 1930’s American heartland, chronicling the mythic conflict and bloody struggle between big money and the downtrodden, God and greed, charlatans, and prophets.
cast: Killian Scott, Logan Marshall-Green, Sarah Jones, Chasten Harmon, Christopher Heyerdahl

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a rural Iowa community during the Great Depression, a stranger with a violent past poses as a preacher and rallies the farmers to mount a strike.

name: FR - Break Point
plot: Travel alongside some of the world's most talented tennis players as they swing for greatness and Grand Slams through an action-packed season.

name: FR - Suisei no Gargantia
plot: While fighting an intense inter-galactic war, a mecha pilot is accidentally warped into a space-time neither he nor his computer recognize. After waking up from a long-time hibernation, he finds himself trapped on a planet, with human residents talking in an unknown form of language, using inferior technologies, and - most shocking to him - naturally breathable air.
cast: Hisako Kanemoto, Kaito Ishikawa, Ai Kayano, Hideaki Tezuka, Kana Asumi

name: FR - César Wagner
plot: Police Captain César Wagner is a compulsive hypochondriac, obsessed with his work. His singular, distinctive style unsettles not only his suspects but also the members of his squad.
cast: Gil Alma, Olivia Côte, Joséphine de Meaux, Fanny Cottençon, Etienne Diallo

name: FR - Leverage: Redemption
plot: The Hitter, the Hacker, the Grifter and the Thief are together again, this time with help from a new tech genius and corporate fixer, to take on a new kind of villain. From the man who created an opioid crisis from the comfort of his boardroom to the shadowy security firm that helps hide dangerous secrets for a price - when someone needs help, they provide... Leverage.
cast: Noah Wyle, Gina Bellman, Christian Kane, Beth Riesgraf, Aleyse Shannon

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In Season Two, the Leverage team put their criminal skills to the test by everything from a husband-and-wife team running a multi-level marketing scam and a shipping magnate dumping boatloads of plastic waste to a music producer who abuses his position over vulnerable women. This season also sees an old friend of Sophie’s unexpectedly coming out of the woodwork, making her question her choices.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: This season, the team pits themselves against a power broker stealing clean water, fight against a Mayor who's both judge and jury of his small town, outrun a mark who's finally caught up with them mid-con, outhustle a pool hustler with a side business in international extortion, and bring down an industrialist exploiting child labor.

name: FR - Mystery Road
plot: When there is a mysterious disappearance on an outback cattle station, Detective Jay Swan is assigned to investigate. Working with local cop Emma James, Jay’s investigation uncovers a past injustice that threatens the fabric of the whole community.
cast: Anthony Hayes, Aaron Pedersen, Colin Friels, Wayne Blair, Sofia Helin

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Mystery Road Series 1 tells the story of Detective Jay Swan, who has been assigned to investigate the mysterious disappearance of two young farmhands on an outback cattle station, one a local Indigenous football hero and the other a white backpacker. Working together with local police sergeant Emma James, the investigation uncovers drug trafficking in the town, and a past injustice that threatens the fabric of the whole community.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: A headless corpse is found floating by the shore in a remote outback town. As if this weren't mysterious enough, Detective Swan and his colleague Fran have to contend with protests against the excavation of an Indigenous site. And then another body turns up…

name: FR - The Killing Kind
plot: Barrister Ingrid Lewis defends John Webster against stalking charges, only for Webster to turn on her.
cast: Emma Appleton, Colin Morgan, Elliot Barnes-Worrell, Olivia D'Lima, Nicholas Rowe

name: FR - JANET JACKSON.
plot: The documentary takes viewers through Janet Jackson's life and career, contain never-before-seen footage, and feature home videos from the legendary artist. Jackson discusses her controversial 2004 Super Bowl halftime show performance with Justin Timberlake, her father Joe Jackson, the death of her brother Michael Jackson, and more.
cast: Janet Jackson, Rebbie Jackson, Katherine Jackson, James 'Jimmy Jam' Harris III, Terry Lewis

name: FR - L’arme du crime
cast: Simon Coutu

name: FR - Everything Sucks!
plot: It's 1996 in a town called Boring, Oregon, where high school misfits in the AV and drama clubs brave the ups and downs of teenage emotions in the VHS era.
cast: Peyton Kennedy, Jahi Di'Allo Winston, Quinn Liebling, Rio Mangini, Sydney Sweeney

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: It's 1996 in a town called Boring, Oregon, where freshman Luke and his friends Tyler and McQuaid join the AV club to become friends with Kate, the Principal's daughter. They also make some enemies with the members of the drama club, only saved and survived by making an intergalactic space movie.

name: FR - Flaked
plot: In his funky California beach enclave, Chip's the go-to guy for personal insights. But he isn't quite as enlightened when it comes to his own baggage.
cast: Will Arnett, David Sullivan, Ruth Kearney, George Basil

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Chip returns to Venice after a short exile and finds that he is persona non grata. No store, no friends, not even a guest house to live in, it’s a long road back to the way things were.

name: FR - Terror in Resonance
plot: In an alternate version of the present, Tokyo has been decimated by a shocking terrorist attack, and the only hint to the identity of the culprit is a bizarre video uploaded to the internet. The police, baffled by this cryptic clue, are powerless to stop the paranoia spreading across the population. While the world searches for a criminal mastermind to blame for this tragedy, two mysterious children - children who shouldn't even exist - masterfully carry out their heinous plan. Cursed to walk through this world with the names Nine and Twelve, the two combine to form "Sphinx," a clandestine entity determine to wake the people from their slumber - and pull the trigger on this world.
cast: Soma Saito, Atsumi Tanezaki, Kaito Ishikawa, Shunsuke Sakuya

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a terrorist attack ravages Tokyo, a mysterious clue to the perpetrators' identity confounds the police, and paranoia spreads like wildfire.

name: AR - اتصال
plot: An elite drug squad detective forced to drug by someone mysterious reveals the whole story of 20 years of friendship and connection with the death of a friend.
cast: Ji Sung, Jeon Mi-do, Kwon Yul, Kim Kyung-nam, Jung Yoo-min

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After his promotion to inspector, Jang Jaegyeong is abducted for three days. Just moments before, he received an SOS text message from a former friend referencing the name "Doctor". The new and potent "Lemon Mulberry" drug is injected into his system and one pill is left in his coat. Suffering withdrawal symptoms and only flashes of what happened to him, he needs to find out the connection between him and this mysterious "Doctor".

name: AR - المبتدئ العجوز
plot: Crushed by his sudden forced retirement, a professional soccer player pivots into a new career when he starts working for a sports management company.
cast: Go Ayano, Kyoko Yoshine, Takashi Sorimachi, Nana Eikura, Taishi Nakagawa

name: AR - موسوري
plot: Based on the backdrop of a beautiful and serene city Mussoorie, the series revolves around a mysterious story of a merciless serial killer 'AKS'. The entire city is in a miff to know about the man behind the endless murders. A fearless journalist Aditi Bisht, daughter of a celebrated senior cop of the city - Ajay Bisht and a wife of reputed cop Rishi Pant is on a mission to solve the case and find the serial killer. But a twist follows when Aditi is shocked to know about the mystery man and plans to close the case without revealing the details to anybody. But well, another surprise awaits, as Aditi gets trapped by a copycat killer claiming himself to be 'AKS'. Will Aditi be able to track down the copycat killer before he reaches the endgame of his deranged puzzle? How long will she be able to hide the truth from her husband or the people of Mussoorie? And will there be collateral damage along the way?
cast: Viraf Patel, Shoaib Ahmed, Ashwini Koul, Jay Bodas, Shriya Pilgaonkar

name: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion
plot: At the turn of the century, the Angels returned to Earth, seeking to wipe out humanity in an apocalyptic fury. Devastated, mankind's last remnants moved underground to wait for the day when the Angels would come back to finish the job. Fifteen years later, that day has come... but this time, humanity is ready to fight back with terrifying bio-mechanical weapons known as the Evangelions. Watch as Shinji, Rei, Asuka and the rest of the mysterious shadow agency Nerv battle to save earth from total annihilation.
cast: Megumi Ogata, Kotono Mitsuishi, Megumi Hayashibara, Yuko Miyamura, Yuriko Yamaguchi

name: FR - ¡García!
plot: In a present-day Spain, divided and on the brink of political chaos, inquisitive millennial investigative reporter Antonia stumbles on a decades-old conspiracy: the existence of a cryogenically frozen super-agent, García, created in a laboratory in the 1950s by General Franco’s fascist secret services. The old-world collides with the new as García and Antonia must learn to work together as they are drawn deeper and deeper into a political conspiracy that threatens to overthrow democracy and plunge Spain back into brutal dictatorship.
cast: Francisco Ortiz, Veki Velilla, Emilio Gutiérrez Caba, Francisco Reyes, Daniel Freire

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A cryogenically frozen super spy from the '60s is thrust into modern-day Madrid.

name: AR - البيت الملعون
plot: Forced into hiding in a mysterious house after a tragic accident, Razan and her two children soon discover that the mysteries within its walls are the least of their worries.
cast: Huda Hussain, Jassim Al-Nabhan, Khaled Ameen, Bassem Moughnieh, Farah Al-Saraf

name: FR - Hotel Cocaine [VOSTFR]
plot: The story of Roman Compte, a Cuban exile and general manager of The Mutiny Hotel, the glamorous epicenter of the Miami cocaine scene of late '70s and early '80s. The Mutiny Hotel was Casablanca on cocaine.
cast: Danny Pino, Michael Chiklis, Yul Vazquez, Mark Feuerstein, Laura Gordon

name: FR - Rebus [VOSTFR]
plot: Iconic character John Rebus is reimagined as a younger Detective Sergeant, drawn into a violent criminal conflict that turns personal when his brother Michael, a former soldier, crosses the line into criminality.
cast: Richard Rankin, Brian Ferguson, Lucie Shorthouse, Amy Manson, Stuart Bowman

name: FR  - Fantasmas
plot: Julio Torres spins a fantastical tale of when he lost a gold oyster earring. In his search to find the precious object, Julio reflects on the offbeat characters he encounters in introspective, often eerie, and always comedic vignettes set in a dreamy, alternate version of New York City.
cast: Julio Torres, Martine Gutierrez, Joe Rumrill

name: FR - Cris Miró (Ella) [VOSTFR]
plot: Cris Miró's journey as Argentina's first trans vedette in 1995, shedding light on the trans community. Despite challenges, she embraced her true self until her untimely passing, leaving a legacy of inspiration and acceptance
cast: Mina Serrano, Katja Alemann, César Bordón, Agustín Aristarán, Victorio D'Alessandro

name: FR - Wave!! Surfing Yappe!!
plot: Follow the story of these beach boys who learned to love the ultimate sport of surfing!
cast: Tomoaki Maeno, Yoshiki Nakajima, Takuya Sato, Yusuke Shirai, Shunichi Toki

name: FR - Violet Evergarden
plot: The war is over, and Violet Evergarden needs a job. Scarred and emotionless, she takes a job as a letter writer to understand herself and her past.
cast: Yui Ishikawa, Daisuke Namikawa, Takehito Koyasu, Aya Endo, Haruka Tomatsu

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The war is over, and Violet Evergarden needs a job. Scarred and emotionless, she takes a job as a letter writer to understand herself and her past.

name: FR - Those About to Die
plot: Within the spectacular, complex and corrupt world of gladiatorial sports in Ancient Rome, follow an ensemble of diverse characters across the many layers of Roman society where sports, politics and business intersect and collide.
cast: Anthony Hopkins, Tom Hughes, Sara Martins, Jojo Macari, Gabriella Pession

name: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace
plot: This stranger-than-fiction series explores the question of whether Natalia Barnett is an exploited Ukrainian child with dwarfism or a dangerous adult masquerading as a child. Featuring exclusive bombshell interviews with members of Natalia's adoptive family, relatives, friends, legal experts, and neighbors, this docuseries offers a never-before-seen glimpse into the Barnett family, Natalia's identity, Michael Barnett's October 2022 trial, as well as key insights into new theories and evidence.
cast: Natalia Grace Rene Mans

seasons.name: Natalia Speaks
seasons.overview: Picking up where the shocking finale of The Curious Case of Natalia Grace left off, Natalia Speaks dives headfirst into the questions, controversies, and secrets unearthed in the first installment, but this time, Natalia shares her side of the story.

seasons.name: The Final Chapter
seasons.overview: The Final Chapter sees Natalia's journey come to a conclusion but not before she is forced to navigate a number of seemingly insurmountable challenges.

name: FR - Qui est la taupe ?
plot: A high-stakes competition series where twelve players work together in challenges to add money to a pot that only one of them will win at the end. Among the players is one person who has secretly been designated "the Mole" and tasked with sabotaging the group's money-making efforts. In the end, one player will outlast their competition and expose the Mole to win the prize pot.
cast: Ari Shapiro, Antonio Alejandro Castellanos, Quaylyn, Sean, Ryan Warner

name: FR - À l'épreuve du diable
plot: It's the ultimate showdown of wits, brains, strategy, and alliances for a chance to win 500 million won.
cast: Ha Seok-jin, Lee Hye-seong, Lee Si-won, Seungkwan, Suh Dong-joo

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: 12 contestants face off in games of wit, strategy and wisdom over 6 nights and 7 days. Who will be crowned the ultimate victor?

seasons.name: Death Room
seasons.overview: The devil will return, more devious and cunning than ever.

name: FR - Cannes police criminelle
plot: Gutsy French detective Camille Delmasse loves her job and her family fiercely. After her father, the former police chief, is accused of corruption, Camille is determined to clear his name. She coerces help from suave con man Harry King, who's in Cannes on a secret quest of his own. Can the sparring duo work together to uncover a conspiracy?
cast: Lucie Lucas, Jamie Bamber, Shy'm, Jean-Hugues Anglade

name: FR - Neumatt
plot: When business consultant Michi Wyss inherits his late father's troubled farm he must confront his rural past -- and his family's future.
cast: Julian Koechlin, Sophie Hutter, Anouk Petri, Jérôme Humm, Marlise Fischer

name: FR - Our Flag Means Death
plot: After trading in the seemingly charmed life of a gentleman for one of a swashbuckling buccaneer, Stede Bonnet becomes captain of the pirate ship Revenge. Struggling to earn the respect of his potentially mutinous crew, Stede’s fortunes change after a fateful run-in with the infamous Captain Blackbeard. Stede and crew attempt to get their ship together and survive life on the high seas.
cast: Rhys Darby, Taika Waititi, Ewen Bremner, Joel Fry, Samson Kayo

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: To their surprise, Stede Bonnet and Captain Blackbeard found more than friendship on the high seas…they found love. Now, they have to survive it.

name: FR - Romancero
plot: Jordán and Cornelia are two young kids who, in the dead of night, are trying to escape the angry mob accusing them of murder. Fearing for their lives, they flee from the law, from the supernatural and even from themselves.
cast: Sasha Cócola, Elena Matić, Ricardo Gómez, Guillermo Toledo, Belén Cuesta

name: FR - Toute la lumière que nous ne pouvons voir
plot: A blind French girl and a young German soldier's paths collide during WWII.
cast: Aria Mia Loberti, Louis Hofmann, Lars Eidinger, Hugh Laurie, Mark Ruffalo

name: FR - Wreck: croisière sanglante
plot: Aboard the mega cruise ship Sacramentum, 20-year-old new recruit, Jamie, infiltrates the 3000-strong crew in a desperate race to find his missing sister. She was working aboard the same vessel on a previous tour and vanished mid-charter.
cast: Warren James Dunning, James Phoon, Oscar Kennedy, Jodie Tyack, Thaddea Graham

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: Jamie Walsh boards mega cruise ship The Sacramentum in search of his missing sister.

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: Jamie and his misfit friends are on the run and infiltrate a mysterious wellness festival.

name: FR - Sambre
plot: Late 80’s in Northern France, women are being sexually assaulted along the same road by the Samber river – with attacks taking place early mornings and in a similar style. The police fail to get to grips with the extent of these assaults or make a connection between the cases. The justice system is overwhelmed by the accumulating cases. It will take 30 years to catch a man, who never stopped attacking women and is responsible for at least 54 cases of rape or sexual assault.
cast: Alix Poisson, Olivier Gourmet, Noémie Lvovsky, Jonathan Turnbull, Pauline Parigot

name: FR - Suburræterna
plot: While chaos rules over Rome, established alliances are at risk as tensions rise with emerging criminal clans. The world of "Suburra" takes a new turn.
cast: Giacomo Ferrara, Filippo Nigro, Carlotta Antonelli, Federica Sabatini, Marlon Joubert

name: FR - Témoin numéro 3
plot: One day at work, Jodie momentarily glances out of the window and in a split second her life descends into freefall. What she notices seems innocuous – two men walking on the opposite side of the road – but she’s actually witnessed a killer and his victim moments before a murder.
cast: Cole Martin, Ruaridh Mollica, Siôn Daniel Young, Nina Toussaint-White, Clare Dunne

name: FR - Temps de chien
plot: Antoine Meilleur is a veterinarian and star host of successful TV shows. He also owns a veterinary hospital and a veritable empire of animal products. But his whole world suddenly changes the day he is plunged into a scandal, despite himself.
cast: François Bellefeuille, Émilie Bibeau, Robin-Joël Cool, Tom Gohier, Nathalie Breuer

name: FR - Tout va bien
plot: An ordinary family faces a catastrophe: the serious illness of one of its children. Each member of the family sees their personal life impacted by this ordeal. Disasters make people more human, though not necessarily better.
cast: Virginie Efira, Nicole Garcia, Sara Giraudeau, Aliocha Schneider, Bernard Le Coq

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A family faces the serious illness of one of its children and its impact on their lives.

name: FR - Zac & Mia
plot: "Zac and Mia", based on the novel by A.J. Betts, about 2 teens battling cancer in the same hospital. In the real world, Zac and Mia would have pretty much nothing in common, but in the hospital, where they're the only 2 teens on the ward, they develop an unbreakable bond. If cancer is the variable that changed everything, the only constant is their ever-deepening need for one another.
cast: Anne Winters, Kian Lawley

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: "Zac and Mia", based on the novel by A.J. Betts, about 2 teens battling cancer in the same hospital. In the real world, Zac and Mia would have pretty much nothing in common, but in the hospital, where they're the only 2 teens on the ward, they develop an unbreakable bond. If cancer is the variable that changed everything, the only constant is their ever-deepening need for one another.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: "Zac and Mia", based on the novel by A.J. Betts, about 2 teens battling cancer in the same hospital. In the real world, Zac and Mia would have pretty much nothing in common, but in the hospital, where they're the only 2 teens on the ward, they develop an unbreakable bond. If cancer is the variable that changed everything, the only constant is their ever-deepening need for one another.

name: FR - Fais-moi peur !
plot: Each season of this horror anthology series follows a different group of kids, members of the Midnight Society, as they discover terrifying curses and creatures.
cast: Conor Sherry, Telci Huynh, Luca Padovan, Dior Goodjohn, Chance Hurstfield

seasons.name: Carnival of Doom
seasons.overview: Members of the Midnight Society tell a terrifying tale of the Carnival of Doom and its evil ringmaster, Mr. Tophat, only to witness the shocking story come frightfully to life.

seasons.name: Curse of the Shadows
seasons.overview: An all-new Midnight Society group of kids learn of the terrifying curse cast over their small seaside town, and are haunted by a mysterious creature known as the Shadowman.

seasons.name: Ghost Island
seasons.overview: A group of kids arrives on an island for a summer vacation, only to learn that their resort is haunted by the ghosts of guests who have gone missing over the years. As they uncover the secrets of the island, the mystery puts them all in danger of becoming the next victims of the curse.

name: AR - المحقق التركي
plot: Inspector Cetin Ikmen, his partner Mehmet Suleyman and Detective Ayse Farsakoglu, solve crimes and experiencing euphoric highs and tragic lows. Each crime story is heavily rooted in the rich and varied culture and history of Istanbul and set against the vibrant, dazzling and frenzied world of modern-day Turkey.
cast: Haluk Bilginer, Ethan Kai, Yasemin Kay Allen

name: AR - سيد المنزل
plot: A family enters a power struggle following the death of their patriarch, who leaves behind his diamond empire — and the housekeeper he recently married.
cast: Narilya Gulmongkolpech, Teerapong Liaorakwong, Chartayodom Hiranyatithi, Nussaba Punnakan, Thanavate Siriwattanakul

name: AR - القائد كاران ساكسينا
plot: As ISI-aided terror looms over the nation, RAW agent Karan Saxena must race against the clock to avert the attacks. But conspirators lurk in every shadow!
cast: Gurmeet Choudhary, Hruta Durgule

name: FR - Devilman Crybaby
plot: Akira Fudo learns from his best friend Ryo Asuka that demons will revive and reclaim the world from humans. With humans hopeless against this threat, Ryo suggests combining with a demon. With this, Akira becomes Devilman, a being with the power of demon but with a human heart.
cast: Koki Uchiyama, Ayumu Murase, Megumi Han, Ami Koshimizu, Atsuko Tanaka

name: FR - 4400
plot: 4400 overlooked, undervalued, or otherwise marginalized people who vanished without a trace over the last hundred years are all returned in an instant, having not aged a day and with no memory of what happened to them. As the government races to analyze the potential threat and contain the story, the 4400 themselves must grapple with the fact that they've been returned with a few "upgrades", and the increasing likelihood that they were all brought back now for a specific reason.
cast: Brittany Adebumola, Joseph David-Jones, Ireon Roach, TL Thompson, Jaye Ladymore

name: FR - Sullivan's Crossing
plot: After Neurosurgeon Maggie Sullivan’s personal and professional life are thrown into turmoil she returns home to Sullivan’s Crossing. While there, Maggie is forced to navigate her complicated present while confronting the painful past she has chosen to ignore for years.
cast: Morgan Kohan, Chad Michael Murray, Tom Jackson, Andrea Menard, Scott Patterson

name: FR - Ten Days in the Valley
plot: Single mother Jane Sadler's life is turned upside down when her young daughter goes missing in the middle of the night. And just like in the controversial police TV show she produces, everything is a mystery, everyone has a secret and no one can be trusted.
cast: Kyra Sedgwick, Erika Christensen, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Abigail Pniowsky, Malcolm-Jamal Warner

name: FR - ABC contre Poirot
plot: 1933. Hercule Poirot, older and greyer, receives letters threatening murder. The sender signs themselves only as “A.B.C.” When he takes the letters to the police looking for help, Hercule finds all his old friends have moved on. But soon there is a murder and the once-great detective must take matters into his own hands.
cast: John Malkovich, Rupert Grint, Eamon Farren, Andrew Buchan, Bronwyn James

name: FR - The Detail
plot: Three fiercely talented female homicide investigators work tirelessly to solve crimes while navigating the complicated demands of their personal lives.
cast: Angela Griffin, Shenae Grimes-Beech, Wendy Crewson, David Cubitt, Al Mukaddam

name: FR - The Fix
plot: High-profile district attorney Maya Travis fled L.A. after devastating defeat when prosecuting an A-list actor for double murder. Eight years later, the same celebrity is under suspicion for another murder, and Maya is lured back to the DA’s office for another chance at justice.
cast: Robin Tunney, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Scott Cohen, Merrin Dungey, Marc Blucas

name: FR - The Little Drummer Girl
plot: Brilliant young actress Charlie strikes up an acquaintance with an intriguing stranger while on holiday in Greece, but it rapidly becomes apparent that his intentions are far from romantic.
cast: Michael Shannon, Alexander Skarsgård, Florence Pugh, Michael Moshonov, Kate Sumpter

name: FR - The Long Song
plot: Set during the final days of slavery in 19th century Jamaica, we follow the trials, tribulations and survival of plantation slave July and her odious mistress Caroline.
cast: Tamara Lawrance, Hayley Atwell, Jack Lowden, Leo Bill, Doña Croll

name: FR - The Knick
plot: Set in downtown New York in 1900, 'The Knick' is centered on the Knickerbocker Hospital and its staff, notably Dr. John Thackery, the hospital's brilliant chief surgeon who pushes medicine's boundaries, pioneering new procedures despite a severe drug addiction.
cast: Clive Owen, André Holland, Jeremy Bobb, Juliet Rylance, Eve Hewson

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 1900, the surgeons and nurses at the Knickerbocker Hospital in New York push the boundaries of medicine in a time of high mortality rates and zero antibiotics. Chief surgeon Dr. John Thackery pioneers new methods in the field while harboring a severe cocaine addiction.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Thackery’s absence, a lack of affluent patients, and financial missteps have led to a decision by the hospital’s board to shutter the downtown location and move uptown, while everyone grapples with both personal and professional challenges.

name: FR - The Road to Calvary
plot: Swept up in political unrest during World War I, two sisters in St. Petersburg cope with turbulent romances as Russian history is made around them.
cast: Sergey Koltakov, Anna Chipovskaya, Andrey Merzlikin, Yuliya Snigir, Aleksey Fokin

name: FR - The Winter King
plot: Bastard son Arthur returns to the land he's been banished from to find a kingdom in chaos. Seeking the aid of his oldest confidants, Arthur aims to right Britain's path as he faces the most unexpected of obstacles.
cast: Iain De Caestecker, Stuart Campbell, Ellie James, Steven Elder, Valene Kane

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A former warrior, now turned monk, tells the story of how Arthur became the lord of war despite the illegitimacy of his throne.

name: FR - The Golden Hour
plot: Mardik, a Dutch detective of Afghan descent, receives word that his childhood friend Faysal has come to the Netherlands. When a terrorist attack occurs the next day, Mardik suspects Faysal and investigates, with drastic consequences.
cast: Nasrdin Dchar, Ellen Parren, Mohammed Azaay, Matteo van der Grijn, Nabil Mallat

name: FR - Un meurtre au bout du monde
plot: Gen Z amateur sleuth and tech-savvy hacker Darby Hart and eight other guests are invited by a reclusive billionaire to participate in a retreat at a remote location. When one of the other guests is found dead, Darby must use her skills to prove it was murder before the killer takes another life.
cast: Emma Corrin, Brit Marling, Harris Dickinson, Alice Braga, Joan Chen

name: FR - Shadow Detective
plot: Taekrok, un vieil inspecteur proche de la retraite, reçoit un appel menaçant d'un inconnu avant d'être accusé de meurtre, à tort. Le maître chanteur se présente comme un ami et propose un jeu. Il ordonne à Taekrok de passer en revue les affaires dont il a été chargé. Le vieil inspecteur fouille désespérément sa mémoire pour découvrir l'identité du maître chanteur ainsi que ses intentions. Taekrok parviendra-t-il au bout de ce jeu palpitant ?
cast: 이성민, 경수진, 이학주, 정진영, 김신록

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Detective Taek-rok receives a threatening call and is falsely charged with murder. He desperately recalls the past to find out who the blackmailer is.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The final counterattack of homicide detective Taek-rok, who returns to pursue the blackmailer's friend's hidden mastermind.

name: FR - Quicksand - Rien de plus grand
plot: After a tragedy at a school sends shock waves through a wealthy Stockholm suburb, a seemingly well-adjusted teen finds herself on trial for murder.
cast: Hanna Ardéhn, Felix Sandman, David Dencik, Rebecka Hemse, Anna Björk

name: FR - Salamandre
plot: A police inspector investigates the robbery of 66 safe deposit boxes at a private bank in Brussels.
cast: Filip Peeters, Koen De Bouw, Mike Verdrengh, Violet Braeckman, Lucas Van den Eynde

name: FR - Sauvetage en Mer De Timor
plot: A group of six friends on a yacht trip from Brisbane to Indonesia come to the aid of a broken-down asylum seekers' boat, leading to a tragic series of events that return to haunt them four years later.
cast: Ewen Leslie, Leeanna Walsman, Phoebe Tonkin, Robert Rabiah, Jacqueline McKenzie

name: FR - Secret City
plot: Beneath the placid facade of Canberra, amidst rising tension between China and America, senior political journalist Harriet Dunkley uncovers a secret city of interlocked conspiracies, putting innocent lives in danger including her own.
cast: Anna Torv, Andrew McFarlane, Benedict Hardie, Robert Rabiah, Don Hany

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A student's protest leads to a government scandal that has personal and professional repercussions for one of Australia's toughest journalists.

seasons.name: Under the Eagle
seasons.overview: Having left journalism behind, Harriet Dunkley strives to unravel a complex government conspiracy from the inside.

name: FR - Secret médical
plot: A series of gripping thrillers that expose the dark side of the people we trust to care for us - doctors.
cast: Ashley Jensen, John Hannah, Alfred Enoch, Richard Rankin, Katie Clarkson-Hill

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: Having lost her job for whistle-blowing, a skilled, hardworking nurse assumes her best friend's identity as a senior doctor to start a new life in Edinburgh.

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: A hospitalised soldier finds patients around him unexpectedly dying.

name: FR - Land of Women
plot: Gala is a New York City socialite on the run in a quaint Spanish town with her mother and daughter. Gala's new life brings her into the path of a brash but charming winery owner—and a deep well of family secrets.
cast: Eva Longoria, Santiago Cabrera, Victoria Bazúa, Carmen Maura

name: FR - Pagan Peak
plot: When a gruesomely staged body is found at the German-Austrian border, two detectives investigate. As the ritual-like murders continue, they enter the killer’s sinister world, set in the Alpine wilderness.
cast: Julia Jentsch, Nicholas Ofczarek

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In the snowy mountains, on a boundary stone between Germany and Austria, lies a strangely staged corpse. Both countries send investigators: the young Ellie Stocker from Berchtesgaden and Gedeon Winter from the Salzburg Kripo. Highly motivated, Stocker takes on her first big case, while Winter, a disillusioned cynic, would prefer to shift the investigation entirely to his German colleague. Interpersonal tensions are inevitable but the two must cooperate because there are more murders and they bear the same signature. It quickly becomes clear that a serial killer is at work.  After the description of a surviving victim, a phantom drawing of the perpetrator is created. It shows the devilish grimace of a Krampus, one of those fearsome companions of Saint Nicholas who punish naughty children. Could the killer be on a mission?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview:
The hunt for the "Krampuskiller" has left its mark on the psyche of detective Ellie Stocker and her Austrian colleague Gedeon Winter is in a coma. When a young tourist is found dead near Salzburg, German and Austrian criminal police have to work together again.

The ambitious young civil servant Yela Antic is allowed to prove her skills for the first time as a liaison officer in the case of the German Tonia Roth, who was murdered in Austria. The body was found in the Zill valley near a river and the murder has distinctive features. Meanwhile, Ellie Stocker has to take a forced break because she's been struggling with flashbacks since the "Krampuskiller" case. Only when another young woman is murdered does she meet Gedeon again.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview:
After Ellie Stocker and Gedeon Winter become bitter opponents at the end of the second season, events bring them together one last time. A series of mysterious murders on both sides of the border rocks the region. While a crime pattern became apparent in the case of the Krampus murderer and Alexander Gössen, the motives for this series of murders initially remain in the dark for the investigators.

The case pushes Ellie and Gedeon to their limits and confronts them with their own story. Because while Gedeon is looking for the tormentor from his childhood, Elli tries against all odds to convict Gedeon of corruption in order to bring the truth about the murder of her colleague Yela Antic to light.

name: FR - Philharmoni
plot: Hélène Barizet is a gifted conductor with a sulphurous reputation. Named against the advice of management and musicians, she has a season to make her place and save the orchestra. The maestro chooses Selena Riviere, a young virtuoso violinist to help her. But how to transmit when all we want is to break with the past?
cast: Marie-Sophie Ferdane, Lina El Arabi, Tomer Sisley, Laurent Bateau, François Vincentelli

name: FR - Pretty Little Liars: The Perfectionists
plot: In Beacon Heights, a seemingly perfect town, a group of three college friends struggle with the stress of being overachievers. In the aftermath of the town’s first murder, each Perfectionist hides behind a secret, a lie and an alibi.
cast: Sasha Pieterse, Janel Parrish, Sofia Carson, Sydney Park, Eli Brown

name: FR - MotherFatherSon
plot: Max is a charismatic self-made American businessman with media outlets in London and around the world. When the self-destructive lifestyle of his 30 year-old son, Caden,  spirals out of control, the devastating consequences threaten the future of the family, its empire, and a country on the brink of change.
cast: Richard Gere, Billy Howle, Helen McCrory, Niamh Algar

name: FR - Profilage
plot: Chloé Saint-Laurent is a profiler and works with a police team to solve murders in Paris. She's very sweet, she wears very colored clothes and a huge yellow bag. She looks like a little girl who need a doll, but she's very smart and a very good profiler. Step by step, she fit in the team and her colleagues, very reserved at first, became her best friends.
cast: Raphaël Ferret, Diane Dassigny, Philippe Bas, Shy'm, Valérie Dashwood

name: AR - ضد البطل
plot: Japan has a conviction rate of 99.9% for criminal cases that go to trial. A lawyer (Hiroki Hasegawa) is able to defeat those odds and obtain an acquittal for his client, even though there's conclusive evidence that says otherwise. Sometimes, due to minor things, good and evil can switch sides and good people can become bad people.
cast: Hiroki Hasegawa, Takumi Kitamura, Mayu Hotta, Oshima Yuko, Yoshino Kimura

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Japan has a conviction rate of 99.9% for criminal cases that goes to trial. A lawyer is able to defeat those odds and obtain an acquittal for his client, even though there's conclusive evidence that says otherwise. Sometimes, due to minor things, good and evil can switch sides and good people can become bad people.

name: FR - Castle
plot: Richard Castle est un écrivain à succès spécialisé dans les thrillers. La police s'intéresse de près à lui lorsqu'un tueur copie les meurtres mis en scène dans ses romans. Une fois cette affaire résolue, Castle devient consultant pour la police de New York...
cast: Nathan Fillion, Stana Katic, Molly C. Quinn, Jon Huertas, Seamus Dever

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A murder-mystery writer and a detective team up to catch a serial killer who is reenacting murders from his books. Once the case is solved, the unlikely pair continue to work together to probe New York City's most unusual homicides.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Best-selling mystery novelist Rick Castle’s unique approach to crime solving may have won over Detective Kate Beckett, but after crossing her, Castle is going to have to do his best work to get her back on his side.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: She’s still armed. He’s still dangerous. And their chemistry is hotter than ever. Season three finds both Richard Castle and Detective Kate Beckett pursuing romantic options of their own. Their signals may be crossed, but this duo hasn’t lost any of their spark. With Beckett’s intrepid police work and Castle’s uncanny insight, solving murder has never been so much fun.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Prepare for a season full of suspense as Castle works to identify Beckett's shooter while Beckett struggles with the aftermath of her near-death encounter. All the while, the duo tackles a new batch of New Your City's most interesting cases.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Now that Castle and Beckett have finally given in to their true feelings for each other, how will it affect their work together? As they try to keep their new relationship under wraps from their co-workers, the unlikely duo must track down the murderer of Beckett's mother, find the perpetrator of a major conspiracy and untangle a line of investigation that links Castle to a ritualistic killing.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview:
After Castle's stunning romantic proposal to Beckett, what happens next? The magnetic crime-fighting couple faces a whole new set of challenges as they juggle wedding plans and their most intriguing cases yet.

Beckett's new job with the Justice Department takes her away from the wisecracking love of her life. But Castle's devotion to his new fiancee - and her fascinating line of work - jeopardizes her career and creates a chain of events that might separate them forever. Back on the home front, Castle is none too pleased to discover his daughter has seemingly been captivated by, and now living with, her new, free-spirited boyfriend.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: The wedding bells are ringing, but will Castle and Beckett really tie the knot? On the biggest day of his life, Castle is nowhere to be found, and it's not because he has cold feet. Now, in a season of brilliant twists and turns, Castle and Beckett take on New York City's most fascinating cases while they try to solve the mystery of their own relationship.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: In the Season 7 finale, Beckett was faced with a choice about her future.  Now that she's been promoted to Captain, how will New York's famous  couple adapt in Season 8?

name: FR - Sons of Anarchy
plot: An adrenalized drama with darkly comedic undertones that explores a notorious outlaw motorcycle club’s (MC) desire to protect its livelihood while ensuring that their simple, sheltered town of Charming, California remains exactly that, charming. The MC must confront threats from drug dealers, corporate developers, and overzealous law officers. Behind the MC’s familial lifestyle and legally thriving automotive shop is a ruthless and illegal arms business driven by the seduction of money, power, and blood.
cast: Charlie Hunnam, Katey Sagal, Tommy Flanagan, Mark Boone Junior, Kim Coates

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The Sons of Anarchy live, ride, and die for brotherhood. But as the club's leader Clay Morrow and his wife Gemma steer them in an increasingly lawless direction, Gemma's son Jax is torn between loyalty and the legacy.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Reeling from the combined pressure of an ATF crackdown and an unprovoked murder, the Sons face a far more deadly threat from a cold-blooded enemy who wil stop at nothing to drive them out of Charming for good. As Jax and Clay square off over questions of leadership and loyalty, lines are drawn and chaos reigns as the club threatens to destroy itself—from the inside out.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: This season begins with SAMCRO feeling powerless over Abel’s kidnapping, especially Jax, whose grief sends him into deeper turmoil over his future with the club. The search for Abel sends our guys to Ireland, where Jax faces not only the Irish Republican Army but an untold personal history as well. Meanwhile, still on the lam, Gemma is hit with unexpected news and risks her freedom to deal with it.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: This season begins with SAMCRO fresh out of jail and back into Charming. Upon their arrival, they encounter new law enforcement and head right back to business. The club is pressed with a decision that could challenge what SOA has always stood for and brings forth an unlikely alliance. Jax, fresh out of jail and dealing with the birth of his new-born son, is forced to put new plans into motion that could affect the club and ultimately his family.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: This season begins with Jax and Tara as the club’s new king and queen after learning the truth behind his father's death and facing the consequences of the club's illicit deeds. Stripped of his patch after Jax discovers he was complicit in John Teller’s death, Clay recovers from gunshot wounds that nearly killed him while Gemma is faced with a new life without the comfort of her family. With the threat of RICO still looming, Jax has to find a way to protect his family and save his club as SAMCRO is pulled into a conflict with a potent new enemy.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Having framed Clay for the murder of Damon Pope, Season Six begins with Jax’s leadership uncontested, but his family life is suffering from his single-minded pursuit of John Teller’s vision. Jax must find a way to keep Tara from going to prison for conspiracy to commit murder while rebuilding his club and breaking from the cycle of violence and greed that ultimately led to his best friend’s death.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: The seventh and final season of Sons of Anarchy begins ten days after the tragic events of Season Six with Jax in jail on a parole violation, grappling with his inner demons. With the club’s full support, he sets in motion the brutal machinations that will lead to complete and merciless retribution.

name: EAR - Snowpiercer
plot: More than seven years after the world has become a frozen wasteland, the remnants of humanity inhabit a gigantic, perpetually-moving train that circles the globe as class warfare, social injustice and the politics of survival play out.
cast: Daveed Diggs, Mickey Sumner, Alison Wright

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After an apocalyptic winter consumes the Earth, humanity’s survivors cling to life aboard a purpose-built train, endlessly looping the globe. First class passengers live in luxury, while those in the tail near-starve, until an unexpected murder sees ‘tailie’ detective Layton pulled to the front in order to investigate.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, an entirely new power struggle emerges, causing a dangerous rift as people are divided between their loyalty to Layton and to Mr. Wilford, who has a new train, new technology and a game plan that keeps everyone guessing. While Layton battles Wilford for the soul of Snowpiercer, Melanie leads the charge on a shocking new discovery that could change the fate of humanity.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season 3 picks up with Layton and his inner circle commanding a small 10-car “pirate train” in search of Melanie and a possible warm location to restart civilization. Meanwhile, back on the train, Mr. Wilford is consolidating power, awaiting Layton’s return.

name: FR - L'Empereur
plot: A charismatic, benevolent young man grows into a tyrannical, ruthless aggressor as his victims come and go.

name: FR - Les enquêtes du commissaire Van der Valk
plot: Set against the backdrop of the city of Amsterdam, Piet Van der Valk and his team investigate a series of high-profile cases immersed in the worlds of art, politics, addiction, mysticism and the fashion industry.
cast: Marc Warren, Maimie McCoy, Darrell D'Silva, Emma Fielding, Django Chan Reeves

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Van der Valk and the team return for another compelling series of murder investigations set against the stunning backdrop of Amsterdam.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Amsterdam's famous detective is back. Van der Valk – a streetsmart and unapologetic Dutch detective who navigates the lively and enigmatic city, solving mysterious crimes using astute human observation and inspired detection.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Van der Valk and his team are back to investigate new crimes in Amsterdam. In addition, Van der Valk must deal with an unwelcome past romance as well as find a way to make one of his beloved team members confront their mortality.

name: FR - Threesome
plot: David and Siri are a young couple living in London. During a night out, they meet Camille and a flirtatious game arises where the boundaries are gradually dissolved. In an act of drunken curiosity, they have a threesome.

name: FR - Gabriel et ses petits démons
plot: A busy executive hires a rancher to care for her kids in a moment of panic. Little does she know he'll challenge her views of gender roles — and of love.
cast: Sandra Echeverría, Moisés Arizmendi, Diana Bovio, Iván Amozurrutia, Anthony Giuletti

name: FR - Cascadeurs
plot: Héléna est à l'étape de tournage pour la scène de combat dans un bar, qu'une comédienne exécutera avec le cascadeur Rodney Alexandre; la scène à préparer demande une attention particulière, puisque l'actrice n'est pas cascadeuse

name: FR - Icon of French Cinema
plot: Returning to Paris after exile from Hollywood, Judith is intent of making a comeback with a new movie. However, her 16-year-old daughter falls in love with her much older dance teacher and Judith is forced to deal with personal ambition, maternal anxiety and the demons of her past with humor and disillusion.
cast: Judith Godrèche, Tess Barthélémy, Liz Kingsman, Gina Cailin, Alma Struve

name: FR - How to Create a Sex Scandal
plot: In 2005, the sleepy community of Mineola, Texas, is thrown into turmoil when local children reveal shocking stories about a pedophile sex ring that took place at a local swingers club. As arrests are made, life sentences handed down, and lives ruined, it soon becomes apparent that there is a lot more to the story than meets the eye. Now, the startling long-term repercussions of the scandal are revealed.

name: FR - Paranormal Revenge
plot: Every episode explores two chilling stories of real-life paranormal encounters that intersect with revenge. Each story unfolds from the perspective of a main storyteller – a victim – who has been targeted by a mysterious paranormal entity or entities. What follows is a truly original and compelling approach: a mash-up of the true-crime procedural and terrifying ghost stories.
cast: Tawney Lewis

name: FR - Réseau pédophile - la traque internationale
plot: 15-year-old Martin calls the police in Bergen, Norway. That phone call leads to an international investigation that exposes a large network of child predators. Explore the shocking details of this disturbing case.

name: FR - 5 gars pour moi
plot: Et si on pouvait trouver le vrai amour chez soi en une semaine? Une célibataire accueillera chez elle cinq hommes dans le but de trouver l’amour. Chaque matin, elle devra faire ses adieux à l’un d’entre eux, pour finalement se retrouver seul à seul avec celui qui fait le plus battre son coeur.

name: FR - L'âge de la colère
plot: A man is found brutally murdered, presumably by his son Marcos, a teenager with no apparent problems. The tragedy hits the school, with students and teachers wondering what went wrong.
cast: Amaia Aberasturi, Carlos Alcaide, Daniel Ibáñez, Manu Ríos, Dani Sabiti

name: FR - Dark Winds
plot: This psychological thriller follows two Navajo police officers, Leaphorn and Chee, in the 1970s Southwest as their search for clues in a grisly double murder case forces them to challenge their own spiritual beliefs and come to terms with the trauma of their pasts.
cast: Zahn McClarnon, Kiowa Gordon, Jessica Matten, Deanna Allison, Elva Guerra

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Leaphorn and Chee, two Navajo police officers in the 1970s Southwest, are forced to challenge their own spiritual beliefs when they search for clues in a double murder case.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Lt. Joe Leaphorn and Jim Chee find themselves in the high desert of Navajo Country chasing a killer who's turned his sights on them to protect a secret that rips open old wounds and challenges Leaphorn's moral and professional code. With the help of Sgt. Manuelito and Valencia County Sheriff Gordo Sena, Leaphorn and Chee must thwart their would-be assassin and restore balance not only to their own lives but to the reservation that depends on them.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Six months after the events of Season 2, Lt. Joe Leaphorn and Jim Chee investigate the disappearance of two boys, with only an abandoned bicycle and blood-stained patch of ground left in their wake. Meanwhile, Bernadette Manuelito attempts to settle into her new life 500 miles from home with the Border Patrol, but stumbles across a conspiracy involving human and drug smuggling with far-reaching implications.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The fourth season focuses on the search for a missing Navajo girl, which takes Leaphorn, Chee and Manuelito from the safety of Navajo Nation to the gritty terrain of 1970s Los Angeles in a race against the clock to save her from an obsessive killer with ties to organized crime.

name: FR - Cruelle Perfection
plot: Song Yeo-wool, a widow who has been falsely accused of her husband’s murder, goes on a dangerous path to discover the truth about her husband’s death, while facing great judgement from the society. With this charge and allegation on her, she gets near about losing everything and becomes devastated. Meanwhile, the parents of students of international school where Yeo-wool’s son studies, starts to spread rumors about Yeo-wool.
cast: Cho Yeo-jeong, Kim Ji-soo, Ha Jun, Park Se-jin, Gong Hyun-joo

name: FR - Fellow Travelers
plot: Decades-long chronicle of the risky, volatile and steamy relationship between the charismatic and ambitious Hawk and the pious and idealistic Tim, two political staffers who fall in love at the height of the 1950s Lavender Scare. Through the Vietnam War protests of the 1960s, the drug-fueled disco culture of the 1970s and the AIDS crisis of the 1980s, the two men’s fiery affair only intensifies despite the constant threat of being exposed and losing everything.
cast: Matt Bomer, Jonathan Bailey, Jelani Alladin, Linus Roache, Noah J. Ricketts

name: FR - Karl Lagerfeld : Révélation
plot: Karl Lagerfeld was an enigmatic figure who spent his life reinventing himself. He ruled the fashion world for decades, making history with his achievements at Chanel, Fendi and his own brand. An extraordinary personality, a fashion Stakhanovite, a tireless worker who created day and night until his last breath. A flamboyant man too, in his appearance and in his words, known for his outbursts mixing perfidy, provocation and self-deprecation. He was also an illusionist, a provocateur, a controversial icon, who used the truth - particularly about his past - to embellish his legend. But where does this determination come from? What were his inspirations and motivations? And behind his enigmatic façade - with his tight suit, ponytail and dark glasses - who really was Karl Lagerfeld?
cast: Karl Lagerfeld, Thierry Ardisson, Jacques de Bascher, Anita Briey, Victoire Doutreleau

name: FR - Après le verdict : les jurés mènent l'enquête
plot: As they return to normal life, four very different Australians who have just finished jury duty on a high-profile murder trial begin to question their verdict and take matters into their own hands, investigating the murder themselves as they juggle the pressures and impacts on their personal lives.
cast: Sullivan Stapleton, Michelle Lim Davidson, Lincoln Younes, Tess Haubrich, Magda Szubanski

name: FR - Furia
plot: Policeman Asgeir moves to an idyllic town in the west part of Norway. After a local conflict, he meets a mysterious woman named Ragna, and soon they are both trapped in a network of right-wing radical forces that threaten Europe.
cast: Pål Sverre Hagen, Ine Marie Wilmann, Borys Szyc, Henrik Schyffert

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Caught in a web of deception, Ellen is branded as the very enemy she's hunting. Join her and the unyielding Asgeir in a race from the Arctic's icy breath to the heartbeats of Budapest and Warsaw, to unravel a deadly plot and clear her tarnished name.

name: FR - Bienvenue au monastère
cast: Baudouin Ardillier, Clara Morgane, Delphine Wespiser, Paul El Kharrat, Jean-Marc Généreux

name: FR - Without Sin
plot: Explores the relationship which develops between a grieving mother and the man she believes murdered her daughter.
cast: Vicky McClure, Johnny Harris, Dorothy Atkinson, Andrea Lowe, Johann Myers

name: FR - Professeur T
plot: Professor Jasper Tempest, a genius Cambridge University criminologist with OCD and an overbearing mother, advises the police. British version of the Belgian crime drama of the same name.
cast: Ben Miller, Emma Naomi, Barney White, Sarah Woodward, Andy Gathergood

name: FR - Davos 1917
plot: More determined than ever to live her life in accordance with her deepest desires, nurse Johanna Gabathuler finds herself embroiled in a spy conspiracy with international implications. There’s a high price to pay and it’s risky to say the least, but she will do anything it takes to find her daughter and, ultimately, secure her freedom.
cast: Dominique Devenport, Jeanette Hain, David Kross, Anna Schinz, Hanspeter Müller

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: More determined than ever to live her life in accordance with her deepest desires, nurse Johanna Gabathuler finds herself embroiled in a spy conspiracy with international implications. There’s a high price to pay and it’s risky to say the least, but she will do anything it takes to find her daughter and, ultimately, secure her freedom.

name: FR - Total Control
plot: A local Indigenous politician is recruited to the senate by the Australian Prime Minister after a contentious video goes viral.
cast: Rachel Griffiths, Deborah Mailman, Anthony Hayes, Wayne Blair

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: Alex Irving is back, but this time she's doing things her way. Can the ultimate outsider find a new way in and take control of a political establishment determined to shake everything she values?

seasons.name: Series 3
seasons.overview: Two years on since the explosive events of the second season, outsider turned kingmaker, Alex Irving, is now completely at home in the nation's capital. She's at the centre of power, holding the Government on a short leash, but it's taking a toll.

name: FR - Meurtre au pied du volcan
plot: L’inspecteur Runarsson est envoyé de Reykjavík sur la péninsule de Snaefellsnes pour enquêter sur ce qui apparaît comme le suicide d’un banquier. Pourtant, certains indices sèment le doute. Pour résoudre ce crime, le policier va devoir faire face à de nombreux obstacles dans cette petite communauté.
cast: Arna Magnea Danks, Salome R. Gunnarsdottir, Unnur Birna Jónsdóttir, Margrét Þorgeirsdóttir, Heida Reed, Jón Páll Eyjólfsson, Ragnar Jónsson, Valur Freyr Einarsson

name: FR - Miguel
cast: Aviv Karmi, Ran Danker, Raúl Méndez, José Mariano Díaz Duarte

name: FR - Miniaturist
plot: A woman moves to live with her new husband in 17th century Amsterdam, but soon discovers that not everything is what it seems. Based on the adaptation by Jessie Burton.
cast: Anya Taylor-Joy, Romola Garai, Alex Hassell, Hayley Squires, Paapa Essiedu

name: TAR - ذاتٌ أُخرى

name: FR - Dans cette vie ou une autre
plot: This series is adapted from the book by Manuel Jabois' "Nos vemos en esta vida o en la otra" (We'll Meet in This Life or the Next). Based on the interview he conducted with Gabriel Montoya Vidal ("Baby") in 2014, it tells of his involvement in the worst Jihadi terrorist attack on European soil in March of 2004.
cast: Roberto Gutiérrez, Quim Àvila Conde, Pol López, Tamara Casellas, Mourad Ouani

Each week, the host receives guest artists from different generations and from multiple backgrounds, in order to share together their music with traditional and folk influences, in an atmosphere designed for staying up late!
cast: Stéphane Archambault

name: FR - L'intégrale j'irai dormir chez vous
cast: Antoine de Maximy

name: FR - IXE-13 et La Course à L'uranium
plot: In Montreal in 1945, a few months after the end of the Second World War, Jean Thibault, aka IXE-13, Canada's top secret service agent, is now the respected owner of the Crystal Club in Red Light and a former hotel above the club that once belonged to the Mafia.
cast: Marc-André Grondin, Julie Le Breton, Hugolin Chevrette, Vincent Leclerc, Marianne Fortier

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In Montreal in 1945, a few months after the end of the Second World War, Jean Thibault, aka IXE-13, Canada's top secret service agent, is now the respected owner of the Crystal Club in Red Light and a former hotel above the club that once belonged to the Mafia.

name: FR - How Music Got Free : La révolution de la musique gratuite
plot: Details the fascinating, and often funny, inside story of the technology-driven disruption that changed music during the late-90s and early-2000s. File sharing technology, combined with the insatiable demand for new music, created both the means and the motive for millions of young people to participate in outright theft – and be celebrated for it.
cast: Rhymefest, Eminem, Method Man, Dell

name: FR - Saucisse Party : Bouff'land
plot: Après avoir tué toute l'humanité, des aliments tentent de créer leur propre utopie.
cast: Seth Rogen, Kristen Wiig, Edward Norton, Michael Cera, Sam Richardson

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After killing off all of humanity, Food attempts to create their own utopia.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, exiled from home, Frank, Barry, and Sammy soon find themselves in New Foodland, a shining utopia for food and humans alike. But beneath the city's glossy fridges and cheery smiles lies a dark secret that threatens the entirety of sentient food society.

name: FR - Moi, Ben
plot: Un enfant de 12 ans, Ben, pris dans les affres des années collège (avec la panoplie du harcèlement, des premiers sentiments amoureux et des bals de fin d’année) tandis qu’il s’adapte à une nouvelle famille recomposée ET à la découverte de pouvoirs surnaturels. Tout au long des 10 épisodes de la saison, Ben part à la découverte de lui-même et apprend ce que signifie réellement le fait d’avoir des super-pouvoirs. Il trouve une alliée en sa sœur par alliance, Max, qui l’aide à exploiter ces pouvoirs et à révéler les secrets qui se cachent derrière les mystères et les tragédies de sa communauté... Le tout alors qu’il essaie de comprendre qui il est.
cast: Lucian-River Chauhan, Abigail Pniowsky, Dilshad Vadsaria, Amanda Reid, Jessy Yates

name: FR - Le pays de Tanabata
plot: Yoji Minamimaru, surnommé Nanmaru, est un étudiant avec la capacité surnaturelle de créer de petits trous dans tout et n'importe quoi. Un jour, Yoji découvre que le professeur d'études folkloriques a disparu. Avec ses camarades de classe, il décide de retrouver le professeur.
cast: 細田佳央太, 藤野涼子, Shuhei Uesugi, 木竜麻生, 鳴海唯

name: FR - Abraham Lincoln
plot: The true story of America's iconic 16th president as told by weaving together both scripted dramatizations of important moments in his life and commentary by authoritative historians and public figures.
cast: Graham Sibley, André Jacobs, Jenny Stead, Colin Moss, Luke Tyler

name: FR - Criminal Record
plot: In the heart of London, an anonymous phone call draws two brilliant detectives—a young woman in the early stages of her career and a well-connected man determined to protect his legacy—into a fight to correct an old miscarriage of justice.
cast: Peter Capaldi, Cush Jumbo, Shaun Dooley, Zoë Wanamaker, Charlie Creed-Miles

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, when a young man is stabbed to death at a political rally, rival police officers June Lenker and Daniel Hegarty are forced into an uneasy alliance. But what starts as a hunt for a murderer escalates into an undercover operation to foil a far-right bomb plot in the heart of London.

name: FR - Huset
plot: Quatre agents pénitentiaires sont contraints d'apporter des changements majeurs dans la prison où ils travaillent pour sauver leur emploi.
cast: Sofie Gråbøl, David Dencik, Charlotte Fich, Youssef Wayne Hvidtfeldt
director: Kim Fupz Aakeson, Michael Noer, Frederik Louis Hviid

name: FR - Les soeurs Spencer
plot: Former police officer Darby Spencer and her mystery novelist mother Victoria Spencer have opposite personalities but still embark on the unlikeliest of ventures: becoming partners in a private detective agency. They are mistaken as sisters as they tackle puzzling cases in Alder Bluffs.
cast: Lea Thompson, Stacey Farber

name: FR - NCIS: Sydney
plot: The brilliant and eclectic team of U.S. NCIS Agents and the Australian Federal Police (AFP) are grafted into a multi-national taskforce to keep naval crimes in check in the most contested patch of ocean on the planet.
cast: Olivia Swann, Todd Lasance, Sean Sagar, Tuuli Narkle, Mavournee Hazel

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season 2, NCIS: Sydney square off against a much more powerful adversary. The investigation into Rankin reveals a looming destructive chaos that threatens the stability of the region. The cases are bigger, locations more exotic, the stakes much higher. With everything on the line, will NCIS: Sydney triumph against all odds – or be torn apart at their very core?

name: FR - The Cool Kids
plot: Three guy friends in a retirement community are the top dogs until they’re blown out of the water by the newest member of the community, a female rebel who’s ready to challenge their place – it’s high school with 70 somethings.
cast: Vicki Lawrence, Martin Mull, David Alan Grier, Leslie Jordan

name: FR - The Woman in the Wall
plot: When Lorna Brady, a survivor of one of Ireland's Magdalene Laundries, wakes to find a corpse in her house, she has no idea who the dead woman is or if she's responsible for the apparent murder, because she has long suffered from extreme bouts of sleepwalking.
cast: Ruth Wilson, Daryl McCormack, Abby Fitz, Mark Huberman, Hilda Fay

name: AR - بنون
plot: A young man from a wealthy family marries a girl after a long love story, and after a period of marriage he does not have children with her. Then his family puts great pressure on him to marry someone else in order to have children, but he discovers that the problem of childlessness is on his part and not on his wife’s side, and events continue.
cast: Hani Adel, Bassant Shawqi, Mahmoud Hegazy, Haya Fayad, Mohamed Hassib

name: FR - Robbie Williams [VOSTFR]
plot: After 25 years of his record-breaking solo career, Robbie looks back on his younger self and reflects on a lifetime spent in the spotlight.
cast: Robbie Williams, Ayda Field, Geri Horner, Guy Chambers

name: AR - البجعة الحمراء
plot: Oh Wan-soo, who married into the powerful Hwain Group, faces death threats. She crosses paths with Seo Do-yoon, a bodyguard investigating a friend's death that is tied to the Hwain Group. Together, they unravel Hwain Group's secrets tainted with desire.
cast: Kim Ha-neul, Rain, Jung Gyu-woon, Seo Yi-sook, Yoon Je-moon

name: FR - Les Dossiers de l'inexplicable
plot: Eerie encounters, bizarre disappearances, haunting events and more perplexing phenomena are explored in this chilling investigative docuseries.
cast: Tijuana Ricks

name: FR - Parasyte : The Grey
plot: When unidentified parasites violently take over human hosts and gain power, humanity must rise to combat the growing threat.
cast: Jeon So-nee, Koo Kyo-hwan, Lee Jung-hyun, Kwon Hae-hyo, Kim In-kwon

name: FR - Un jour
plot: After spending graduation night together, Emma and Dexter go their separate ways — but their lives remain intertwined.
cast: Ambika Mod, Leo Woodall

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: After spending graduation night together, Emma and Dexter go their separate ways — but their lives remain intertwined.

name: FR - Je peux te dire un secret ?
plot: Three women's lives are changed forever when a prolific stalker infiltrates their social media accounts. And they're only a fraction of his many victims.
cast: Savannah Gracey

name: FR - James Herriot, chroniques d'un jeune vétérinaire
plot: The heartwarming and humorous adventures of a young country vet in the Yorkshire Dales in the 1930s. A remake of the 1978 series.
cast: Nicholas Ralph, Samuel West, Anna Madeley, Callum Woodhouse, Rachel Shenton

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As new veterinarian James Herriot gets to know his new family at Skeldale House—his erratic boss Siegfried Farnon, his wayward brother Tristan and the shrewd housekeeper Mrs Hall—he is also drawn to local farmer’s daughter Helen Alderson.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: As series two opens, three months have passed since the events of the first series. A trip back home to Glasgow presents James with a dilemma that will mean choosing between the people he loves. As Helen and James navigate their feelings for one another, Siegfried, Tristan, and Mrs Hall are also forced to consider their places in the world, while James must ultimately decide between duty and love.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season 3 begins in spring 1939 as James and Helen prepare to walk down the aisle. James will have a new wife and a new stake in the business to think of. Helen also faces new challenges, not least of them letting go of her old life. Tristan, having passed his exams at long last, must now face the world as a qualified vet. Mrs. Hall may be ready to open up to affection beyond her work family…and cricket. As war with Germany looms on the horizon, Siegfried contends with painful memories of his own experiences during the First World War.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Picking up in springtime of 1940 with change on the horizon for everyone in Skeldale House. James and Helen wonder when the right time might be to start a family, not knowing whether or not James will be called up to serve in the RAF. Tristan's absence is felt by all, but no one more than Siegfried who attempts to hold the growing household, and himself, together as he braves this new world. Mrs Hall and Helen's friendship blossoms as they look to the future and new trainee veterinary student Richard Carmody arrives, causing complications in the house.

name: FR - Les Oubliées
plot: A detective works to solve a string of cases involving missing girls.
cast: Jacques Gamblin, William Nadylam, Fabien Aïssa Busetta, Nathalie Besançon, Priscilla Attal-Sfez

name: FR - Robbie Williams
plot: After 25 years of his record-breaking solo career, Robbie looks back on his younger self and reflects on a lifetime spent in the spotlight.
cast: Robbie Williams, Ayda Field, Geri Horner, Guy Chambers

name: FR - Lucrecia: A Murder in Madrid
plot: A poor, black immigrant woman is shot and killed in Madrid. The crime triggers an unprecedented social reaction. Who killed Lucrecia? Why? The first clues point to far-right groups. Three decades after the crime, Lucrecia's story stands as a journey to the roots of hatred. With previously unpublished footage, this moving narrative brings to light a crime that goes down in Spanish history as its first racist murder.

name: FR - Clean Sweep
cast: Tava Smiley, Eric Stromer, Peter Walsh

name: FR - De Pierre en fille
cast: Julianne Côté, Patrice Robitaille, Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse

name: FR - El Inmortal
plot: Consists of the fictionalization of the story of 'Los Miami's', a criminal organization led by 'El inmortal' that controlled the cocaine trade in Madrid in the 1990s.
cast: Álex García, Emilio Palacios, Marcel Borràs, Jason Day, María Hervás

name: FR - Garde côtière
cast: Olivier Tremblay, Audrey Savard, Stéphane De Broucker

name: FR - Grace
plot: Brighton based Detective Superintendent Roy Grace is a hard-working police officer who has given his life to the job, but his career is currently at rock bottom. He’s fixated by the disappearance of his beloved wife, Sandy, and running enquiries into long forgotten cold cases with little prospect of success. Following another reprimand for his unorthodox police methods, Grace is walking a career tightrope and risks being moved from the job he loves most.
cast: John Simm, Richie Campbell, Brad Morrison, Amaka Okafor, Laura Elphinstone

seasons.name: Series 3
seasons.overview: As East Sussex police bid farewell to ACC Alison Vosper, the announcement of her replacement is not welcome news for Grace. Shaken by the recent sighting of Sandy, Roy attempts to get closer to the truth while trying to move forward with Cleo, as he is drawn into three sinister investigations. A chilling serial offender from Grace’s past, a road traffic accident which unleashes a web of vengeance and a shocking murder attempt on the Brighton music scene, all test Grace’s skill as past and present collide for Roy, forcing him to confront old memories and learn from previous mistakes.

name: FR - Le grand chantier RONA
cast: Daniel Corbin, Marie-Lyne Joncas, Pierre-Olivier Cantin

name: FR - Smiling Friends
plot: Smiling Friends Inc. is a small company whose main purpose is to bring happiness and make people smile. The series follows the day-to-day lives and misadventures of its representatives, the lazy, cynical Charlie, and the cheerful, optimistic Pim, as they try to cheer up and comfort the troubled people who call their company's hotline. They receive seemingly simple requests but the jobs turn out to be more complicated than they seem, making it difficult to bring happiness to the world.
cast: Michael Cusack, Zach Hadel, Marc M.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A small company dedicated to bringing happiness to the world receives a simple request to help a woman's unhappy son smile again, spiraling the series into more and more bizarre and wild adventures.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, the gang continues to help people smile but end up getting themselves into a more sticky situation each time.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season Three finds Pim, Charlie, Flint and the whole gang going absolutely bonkers once again, diving headfirst into their ultimate quest to spread joy upon the land. We'll see a bunch of unexpected stuff here such as Mr. Frog running full speed at the camera, the team finally collecting all the spirit gems they need, and a totally epic showdown spectacle with an Ancient Witch of some sort. AHHHHH!!!!

name: FR - The Gypsy Bride
plot: Set in the heart of the Spanish Romani community, the fiction follows police inspector Elena Blanco and her team, as they try to crack the crime case pertaining to the murders of sisters Lara and Susana Macaya, separated by a 7-year gap.

name: FR - KONOSUBA - God's blessing on this wonderful world!
plot: After a traffic accident, Kazuma Sato’s  disappointingly brief life was supposed to be over, but he wakes up to  see a beautiful girl before him. She claims to be a goddess, Aqua, and  asks if he would like to go to another world and bring only one thing  with him. Kazuma decides to bring the goddess herself, and they are  transported to a fantasy world filled with adventure, ruled by a demon  king. Now Kazuma only wants to live in peace, but Aqua wants to solve  many of this world’s problems, and the demon king will only turn a blind  eye for so long…
cast: Jun Fukushima, Sora Amamiya, Rie Takahashi, Ai Kayano

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview:
After dying a laughable and pathetic death on his way back from buying a game, high school student and recluse Kazuma Satou finds himself sitting before a beautiful but obnoxious goddess named Aqua. She provides the NEET with two options: continue on to heaven or reincarnate in every gamer's dream—a real fantasy world! Choosing to start a new life, Kazuma is quickly tasked with defeating a Demon King who is terrorizing villages. But before he goes, he can choose one item of any kind to aid him in his quest, and the future hero selects Aqua. But Kazuma has made a grave mistake—Aqua is completely useless!

Unfortunately, their troubles don't end here; it turns out that living in such a world is far different from how it plays out in a game. Instead of going on a thrilling adventure, the duo must first work to pay for their living expenses. Indeed, their misfortunes have only just begun!

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The story continues to follow Kazuma and the rest of his party through countless more adventures as they struggle to earn money and have to deal with one another's problematic personalities. However, things rarely go as planned, and they are often sidetracked by their own idiotic tendencies.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview:
Kazuma Satou, former NEET and current reincarnated adventurer, finally returns home after the incident at the Crimson Demon village. Following their recent exploits, the party is one step closer to vanquishing the Demon King and his armies—a terrifying task that Kazuma is eager to ignore for as long as possible. Things, however, are not going as smoothly as the group would like; they are constantly racking up debt, getting sidetracked during missions, and falling into traps due to their recklessness and eccentricities.

As the party struggles with their perennial issues, they receive an invitation from a princess interested in hearing tales of the group's "heroic" deeds. Darkness' pleas to refuse the invitation only fire the others up to accept it, marking the start of yet another uncanny adventure with unforeseen consequences.

name: TAR - لحن الحياة مدبلج
plot: Melek and Kerim are betrothed at a young age by their fathers. Time passes and Kerim's family gets rich. Meanwhile Melek's family continues to struggle in life. Hülya, Melek's sister, is determined to run away from her poor life. She will do what it takes to get herself accepted into Kerim's family.
cast: Burcu Biricik, Birkan Sokullu, Ahmet Mümtaz Taylan, Tayanç Ayaydın, Ecem Özkaya

name: EAR - الرحلة الأسطورية
cast: Roly Gutiérrez, Benny Emmanuel, Mayte Cordeiro, Andrés Couturier, Ricardo O'Farrill, Alondra Hidalgo
director: James Krieg, Jose C. Garcia de Letona, Ernie Altbacker

name: FR - Ninja Kamui [VOSTFR]
plot: A team of assassins exacts a bloody retribution on Joe Logan – a former ninja who escaped his clan – and his family for betraying their ancient code. Rising from his seeming "death," Joe will re-emerge as his former self – Ninja Kamui – to avenge his family and friends and bring down the very clan that made him.
cast: Kenjiro Tsuda, Atsushi Ono

name: FR - Infidèle
plot: The story of Emma Sandrelli, a doctor who is close to her patients and caring mother, whose life is about to explode when she learns that her husband has had an affair with a young woman for several months. Then begins for her a real descent into hell that will lead her very, very far...  Adaptation of the British series "Doctor Foster."
cast: Claire Keim, Jonathan Zaccaï, Chloé Jouannet, Vanessa David, Félix Lefebvre

name: FR - Indian Summers
plot:
Epic drama set in the summer of 1932 where India dreams of independence, but the British are clinging to power. 

Set against the sweeping grandeur of the Himalayas and tea plantations of Northern India, the drama tells the rich and explosive story of the decline of the British Empire and the birth of modern India, from both sides of the experience. At the heart of the story lie the implications and ramifications of the tangled web of passions, rivalries and clashes that define the lives of those brought together in this summer which will change everything.
cast: Julie Walters, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Nikesh Patel, Jemima West, Alexander Cobb

name: FR - In The Vault
plot: Liv vit son premier semestre à la fac, l'occasion rêvée pour elle de se réinventer et d'expérimenter de nouvelles choses. Dès les premiers jours, elle se lie d'amitié avec Jane, sa colocataire et trouve même l'amour dans les bras de Taylor, super star de cinéma qui se trouve dans la même université.  Un début très prometteur pour cette jeune promo, enfin jusqu'à cette soirée où tout a basculé... Qui croire ? Qui est innocent ? Derrière les secrets de chacun, les soupçons montent.

name: AR - ميرزابور
cast: Ali Fazal, Pankaj Tripathi, Shweta Tripathi Sharma, Divyendu Sharma, Rasika Dugal, Kulbhushan Kharbanda, Harshita Gaur, Prashansa Sharma
director: Karan Anshuman, Puneet Krishna, Vineet Krishnan

cast: Gulshan Devaiah, Anurag Kashyap, Harleen Sethi, Saurabh Sachdeva, Aishwarya Sushmita
